The International Energy Agency announced on Friday that the global oil market is shifting back to a surplus in the fourth quarter. This change is driven by Middle East exports recovering faster than global demand, despite ongoing shipping attacks. Previously, the Paris-based agency had forecast a supply deficit for the fourth quarter. Following the report, oil prices fell slightly, with Brent crude down 0.1% at $95.71 a barrel.

The agency reported that total oil supply will average 105 million barrels per day in the fourth quarter, exceeding forecast demand by 1.7 million barrels per day. Gulf oil producers have increased exports since the war in Iran began in late February by utilizing workarounds like dark crossings through the Strait of Hormuz to avoid attacks. Additionally, OPEC+ pumped 41.23 million bpd in October, reaching 97% of its pre-war February volume.

To help ease market tightness, the IEA provided more details on its emergency reserve release, stating that 71 million barrels will be made available by the end of February, including 15 million barrels of diesel. The organization also suggested that members assess the need for additional diesel releases. High oil prices have further contributed to curbing demand this year, helping transition the market into a surplus.

Looking ahead, global oil demand is projected to drop by 2.7 million barrels per day in 2026 to 102.3 million bpd before increasing by 2 million bpd in 2027. Production is also expected to rise from nations outside OPEC+, including the United States, Canada, Brazil, Argentina, and Guyana, which will add 1.6 million bpd this year. By 2027, global supply is projected to reach 108.1 million bpd, resulting in a supply surplus of approximately 3.8 million bpd.

stories.title: Field Marshal Asim Munir Stresses Benefits for Local Communities at Forum
stories.summary:
Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir emphasized that mines and mineral development must provide tangible benefits to local communities during his address on Friday. Speaking at the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026 in Islamabad, the Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces stated that Pakistan intends to become a competitive hub for long-term mineral investment and seeks to unlock the nation's mineral wealth as a collective national objective.

To safeguard the industry, the field marshal noted that security forces are implementing comprehensive measures to protect the entire mining ecosystem. This includes ensuring the safety of mines, miners, investments, industries, projects, and personnel associated with the sector. He stressed the importance of moving past raw exports toward value-added growth, noting that Pakistan aims to develop the entire value chain from refining to manufacturing alongside forming sustainable international partnerships.

Highlighting the human element, the field marshal praised Pakistanis as hardworking and courageous people who act as the primary source of strength for achieving national aspirations. He reiterated that developing the country's mineral resources requires sustained investment, long-term partnerships, and cooperative national efforts to turn potential into actual production.

Meanwhile, in Karachi, a water shortfall of approximately 130 million gallons per day occurred as K-Electric initiated annual maintenance work at the Dhabeji Pumping Station on Friday. The maintenance required a temporary suspension of power supply to multiple pump houses, according to a spokesperson for the Karachi Water and Sewerage Corporation.

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Suspends December Local Government Election Schedule
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court suspended the Election Commission of Pakistan's notification for local government elections in the federal capital. Justice Omer Majid Malik issued the stay order on Friday while hearing a petition filed by citizen Amjad Ali, halting the polls that had been scheduled for December 20.

During the hearing, Advocate Adil Aziz Qazi argued on behalf of the petitioner that the ECP had overlooked legal requirements while managing the electoral process, despite its legal obligation to ensure free, fair, and transparent elections. Accepting the request for suspension, the court issued notices to the ECP and other relevant respondents, directing them to submit detailed replies by November 26.

The court order effectively pauses the election schedule issued on October 21 until the respondents present their responses. This decision adds to a lengthy history of delays for Islamabad's local governance. The last local government elections in the federal capital took place in 2015, and the constitutional term of the elected body expired in February 2021.

Over the past five years, residents have remained without elected local representatives due to repeated legislative amendments, altered union council counts, and frequent schedule changes. The ECP had previously re-announced the December 20 polling date following the withdrawal of a February 15, 2026 schedule, which was postponed due to a Presidential Ordinance altering local government structures.

stories.title: Financial and Industrial Stocks Cause Sri Lankan Shares to Close Lower
stories.summary:
Sri Lankan shares closed lower on Friday, pushed down primarily by losses in financial and industrial stocks. The CSE All-Share index finished the session down 0.6% at 22,024.18 points. Among the biggest drags on the index were Hatton National Bank and Richard Pieris, which dropped 1.9% and 6.2%, respectively.

Despite the downward pressure on index values, market activity increased during the session. Trading volume rose to 100.7 million shares, up from 87.1 million shares in the previous trading session.

Market turnover also saw an increase, climbing to 3.23 billion Sri Lankan rupees, equivalent to approximately $9.71 million, compared to 2.98 billion rupees previously.

Exchange data revealed a split in investor participation during the session. Foreign investors acted as net buyers, acquiring stocks valued at 56.7 million rupees, whereas domestic investors operated as net sellers, offloading shares worth 3.21 billion rupees.

stories.title: Pakistan Short-Term Inflation Rises to 11.21 Percent Due to Perishable Food Costs
stories.summary:
Short-term inflation in Pakistan climbed to 11.21 per cent year-on-year for the week ending November 12, according to official figures released by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics on Friday. The calculation is based on the Sensitive Price Index, which monitors 51 essential items across 50 markets in 17 cities. During the surveyed week, prices for 19 commodities increased, nine dropped, and 23 remained unchanged. The double-digit inflation rate was driven largely by increases in perishable food items and liquefied petroleum gas.

The index showed that items recording the highest week-on-week price hikes included tomatoes at 12.06 per cent, eggs at 5.98 per cent, potatoes at 2.42 per cent, garlic at 1.76 per cent, and chicken at 1.32 per cent. Conversely, notable price declines were observed for petrol down 7.42 per cent, diesel down 6.10 per cent, and onions down 1.70 per cent. On an annual basis, items like liquefied petroleum gas surged by 111.35 per cent, tomatoes by 78.94 per cent, and electricity for the first quarter by 52.38 per cent.

Energy costs continue to fuel inflationary pressures and indirectly boost sales tax collections through higher prices for everyday goods and services. This dynamic reflects cost-push inflation, placing mounting financial pressure on households. While petroleum and diesel prices have begun a slow decline over recent consecutive days, their impact will only appear in subsequent reviews. Previously, short-term inflation stood at 12.31 per cent year-on-year.

The tracking of these weekly metrics provides a detailed look at how price fluctuations in both food and non-food categories impact the cost of living. The continuous monitoring helps economists and policymakers understand consumer market pressures across the country. Official data collection remains vital for evaluating short-term economic shifts as households navigate fluctuating commodity values.

stories.title: Global Microsoft Outage Disrupts Outlook, Teams, and Copilot Services
stories.summary:
Microsoft’s Outlook, Teams, and Copilot experienced a major global outage lasting over 12 hours due to server issues, disrupting communications for businesses and governments worldwide. The tech giant stated it was implementing fixes more broadly to achieve a persistent recovery and noted it was not aware of any malicious activity. The disruption affected government agencies in Australia, Japan, and the United States, alongside trading firms and airlines.

In Europe, stock exchange operator Euronext reported email communication hurdles, while British insurer Aviva activated backup plans for earnings calls. Danish shipping company Maersk warned customers of delayed updates, and US artificial intelligence firms OpenAI and Anthropic encountered problems with Microsoft connectors. Indian airlines IndiGo, Akasa Air, and Air India also saw their email support services impacted by the technical failure.

The incident caused significant operational hurdles in Taiwan, where fund management at securities firms, life insurers, and investment trust companies was disrupted. One Taiwanese financial entity canceled a bond repurchase transaction, while another resorted to using a fax machine to confirm trades. In the United States, electric truck maker Workhorse Group rescheduled its financial results, and Switzerland's Richemont briefly delayed its earnings announcement.

This event marks the second major disruption to hit Microsoft’s 365 services this year, following previous issues in January and October of last year. Analysts noted that while customers are unlikely to abandon the Microsoft ecosystem immediately, recurring reliability problems give IT departments reason to reconsider depending on a single provider. Government officials, including Australian Cyber Security Minister Tony Burke and Japanese Deputy Chief Cabinet Secretary Masanao Ozaki, confirmed that authorities and information system infrastructures were actively dealing with the email-related fallout.

stories.title: Presidential House Denies Provincial Discussions in Zardari-Naqvi Meeting
stories.summary:
The President’s House on Friday formally rejected media speculations regarding a meeting between President Asif Ali Zardari and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, clarifying that no provincial matters were discussed. The denial followed a surprise visit by Naqvi to Nawabshah to meet the president, which had sparked rumors that they discussed proposals for creating new provinces and holding a related public referendum. The presidential spokesperson emphasized that the discussions strictly focused on national security and the broader regional situation.

The debate over administrative restructuring and the creation of new provinces intensified after Interior Minister Naqvi criticized the country's governance model at the Pakistan Economic Summit 2026 in Islamabad on July 31. Naqvi argued that decentralization is necessary to deliver timely justice and improve public services, drawing mixed reactions from political figures. While leaders like PML-N's Rana Sanaullah questioned Naqvi's critique, others like Defence Minister Khawaja Asif expressed support. Meanwhile, the Sindh Assembly passed a resolution on September 4 rejecting any division of the province, and MQM-P leader Mustafa Kamal has continuously advocated for carving new provinces out of Sindh.

Legal experts have noted that establishing new provinces involves a rigorous constitutional process rather than a simple public referendum. Any boundary changes require formal constitutional amendments, including approval from the relevant provincial assembly. This makes the ongoing political discourse significant not just for administrative efficiency, but also for the constitutional distribution of power between federal, provincial, and local governments.

The clarification from the President's House aims to quell growing political speculation surrounding Naqvi's urgent visit. As discussions about governance reforms continue across Pakistan, the clear delineation between national security talks and administrative restructuring remains a focal point for political observers and lawmakers alike.

stories.title: چینی محققین کا برقی کنگھی سے موروثی گنج پن کا علاج دریافت کرنے کا دعویٰ
stories.summary:
چین کے محققین نے موروثی گنج پن کے موثر علاج کے لیے ایک نئی ’برقی کنگھی‘ تیار کرنے کا دعویٰ کیا ہے، جس کی تحقیق سائنسی جریدے نیچر کمیونیکیشنز میں شائع ہوئی ہے۔ اس آلے کا نام ’ڈی ٹینگل‘ رکھا گیا ہے، جو کہ سنہ 2010 کی اینی میٹڈ فلم ’ٹینگلڈ‘ سے متاثر ہو کر رکھا گیا ہے۔

موروثی گنج پن، جسے سائنسی زبان میں اینڈروجینیٹک ایلوپیشیا کہا جاتا ہے، دنیا بھر میں ڈیڑھ سے دو ارب افراد کو متاثر کرتا ہے جس میں بالوں کی جڑیں کمزور ہو کر سکڑ جاتی ہیں۔ گنج پن کے علاج میں روایتی دواؤں اور سوئیوں کے استعمال کے مسائل کے پیش نظر محققین نے ایک ایسی کنگھی بنائی ہے جس کے دندانوں میں الیکٹروڈز نصب ہیں تاکہ دوائیں اور ضروری مادے براہ راست بالوں کی جڑوں تک پہنچائے جا سکیں۔

یہ کنگھی سر کی جلد پر ایک عارضی اور طاقتور برقی میدان پیدا کرتی ہے جو خلیات کی بیرونی تہہ کو متاثر کر کے علاجی اجزا کو تقریباً 660 مائیکرومیٹر گہرائی تک پہنچانے میں مدد دیتی ہے۔ اس برقی تحریک کا مقصد بالوں کی جڑوں تک خون کی فراہمی بڑھانا اور بال گرنے کے ذمہ دار حیاتیاتی عمل کو کم کرنا ہے۔

فی الحال یہ تجربات انسانوں کے بجائے گنج پن کے شکار چوہوں پر کیے گئے ہیں۔ نتائج کے مطابق برقی تحریک اور بالوں کی نشوونما کے اجزا کے مشترکہ استعمال سے چوہوں میں ایک ماہ کے اندر متاثرہ حصوں پر تقریباً مکمل بال دوبارہ اگ آئے، تاہم اس کے انسانوں کے لیے محفوظ اور مؤثر ہونے کا فیصلہ مزید طبی آزمائشوں کے بعد ہی کیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: Tata Motors Reports Quarterly Loss Driven by Jaguar Land Rover Restructuring Costs
stories.summary:
India-based Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles announced a consolidated net loss for the July-September quarter on Friday, weighed down by exceptional restructuring charges at its luxury British unit, Jaguar Land Rover. The company reported a second-quarter consolidated loss of 55.31 billion rupees, or approximately $587.48 million, contrasting sharply with a profit of 761.7 billion rupees during the same period in the previous year. Exceptional charges for the quarter totaled 67.38 billion rupees.

The Jaguar Land Rover unit has been navigating recovery following a cyberattack that previously disrupted production and sales. Additionally, the automaker is undertaking an extensive restructuring program encompassing asset impairments and employee separation costs. Despite these bottom-line losses and pressures on margins and cash generation, Tata Motors posted a consolidated revenue rise to 969.20 billion rupees, up from 723.49 billion rupees in the corresponding period last year.

The automaker's financial results contrast with domestic peers Maruti Suzuki and Hyundai Motor India, which reported declines in quarterly profits, while Mahindra and Mahindra recorded an increase. JLR's overall performance remains a critical element for Tata Motors' financial health and overall profitability. Meanwhile, the parent company, Tata Sons, faces an internal governance dispute regarding the reappointment of chairman N. Chandrasekaran, as majority shareholder Tata Trusts opposes the board's decision.

stories.title: Paytm Secures Preliminary Central Bank Approval for Wallet Licence
stories.summary:
India's digital financial services provider Paytm has obtained preliminary approval from the central bank for its payments services unit to issue prepaid payment products, including digital wallets. Announced on Friday, this in-principle clearance permits Paytm Payments Services to operate its wallet business independently from Paytm Payments Bank, which previously housed the service for years. After receiving final authorization from the Reserve Bank of India, the company will be allowed to offer prepaid payment instruments to its customers.

Market analysts view the development as an indication of easing regulatory friction that brings positive market sentiment. Anand Dama, executive director and head of banking and financial services research at Nuvama Institutional Equities, noted that the licence will create new revenue avenues, such as a prepaid card business. However, because this is only an initial approval, the final licence will take time, meaning any potential revenue impact will likely not materialize until the financial year 2028. Following the announcement, Paytm shares climbed up to 1.8 percent to 1,960 rupees before closing 0.8 percent higher on Friday, pushing the stock up nearly 50 percent for the year due to robust business growth.

Paytm originally launched its digital wallet business in 2014, growing it into the largest digital wallet provider nationwide before transferring operations to Paytm Payments Bank in 2017 to comply with regulatory requirements. The business faced severe setbacks in 2022 when the Reserve Bank of India prohibited the bank from onboarding new customers. Regulatory scrutiny intensified in 2024 as the central bank restricted the bank from accepting fresh deposits, credits, and top-ups for existing accounts and wallets because of persistent non-compliance and supervisory issues, effectively halting regular wallet loading. These accumulated restrictions ultimately led to the cancellation of the bank's licence earlier this year and its subsequent winding up.

stories.title: Copper Hits Four-Month Low Amid Fifth Consecutive Weekly Drop
stories.summary:
Copper prices declined to their lowest level in nearly four months on Friday, marking the metal's fifth consecutive weekly drop amid growing anxieties surrounding artificial intelligence investments. Benchmark three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange dipped 0.5 percent to $13,519 per metric ton after touching $13,456 earlier in the session, its weakest price point since July 17. The industrial metal faced a 1.8 percent loss for the week, extending a downward trajectory that began in mid-October.

According to Goldman Sachs analysts, London Metal Exchange copper prices have dropped about 7 percent over the past month to $13,588 per ton, largely driven by volatility in artificial intelligence-related equities following a Democratic sweep in the United States midterm elections. Investor caution deepened further after the unexpected resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on Thursday. Goldman Sachs attributed the recent price correction primarily to positioning rather than deteriorating fundamentals, noting that positioning could remain subdued if equity markets begin pricing in an earlier deceleration in artificial intelligence capital spending while data center construction proceeds.

Despite the global sell-off, physical supply remains constrained in top consuming nation China, where local inventories are low and import premiums are high. Copper stockpiles within Shanghai Futures Exchange warehouses contracted by an additional 18.3 percent this week to reach 27,642 tons, representing the lowest volume since December 23. Furthermore, the Yangshan copper premium, which serves as a gauge for Chinese import appetite, reached a record $285 per ton on Friday. Other base metals also trended downward alongside a strong United States dollar, with aluminium, zinc, lead, and nickel all seeing losses, while tin emerged as the sole gainer by rising 0.9 percent to $47,080 per ton.

stories.title: Gold Prices in Pakistan Decrease Following International Market Losses
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a downward correction on Friday, following a similar downward trend observed in the international market. Rates shared by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association indicate that the local market price of gold dropped by Rs4,900 per tola during the day, bringing the new price to Rs411,636 per tola. In addition, the price for 10 grams of gold fell by Rs4,201, resulting in a selling price of Rs352,911.

This drop follows even sharper declines recorded on the previous day. On Thursday, the price of gold per tola fell significantly by Rs10,900, reaching Rs416,536. The domestic reductions mirror movements on the global stage, where the international rate of gold decreased by $49, settling at $3,891 per ounce.

Alongside the yellow metal, the local silver market also saw a downward adjustment on Friday. The price of silver dropped by Rs111, reaching a total of Rs5,467 per tola according to the data provided by the association.

stories.title: Islamabad Constable Arrested for Accepting Bribe to Free Beggar
stories.summary:
Islamabad Capital Territory Police arrested Constable Afzal Ahmed for allegedly taking a bribe to let a female beggar escape from custody. The arrest highlights the department's firm stance against internal corruption.

Authorities registered a case against the officer at the Ramna Police Station following the incident. He will now go through formal legal proceedings.

Senior Superintendent of Police Operations Qazi Ali Raza stated that corrupt personnel will receive no leniency and face both departmental and legal consequences. He emphasized that nobody stands above the law in the department.

The SSP stressed that exploiting the police uniform for personal gain remains completely unacceptable. Officials whose actions harm the force's reputation have no place in the organization.

Internal accountability will persist across the agency to maintain discipline and transparency. Any employee caught abusing their authority will face punishment regardless of their rank.

stories.title: Pakistani Rupee Edges Up Slightly Against US Dollar
stories.summary:
The Pakistani rupee posted a marginal increase against the US dollar within the inter-bank market. The local currency finished the session at 276.60, rising by Re0.01 compared to the previous day's close of 276.61.

Globally, the US dollar remained near a 19-month peak following strong weekly gains. Speculation grew regarding a potential larger interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve, while Treasury yields climbed after remarks from US President Donald Trump regarding Iran.

The euro hovered near its lowest valuation against the dollar since April 2025, while the Japanese yen stayed close to the key 160 threshold. Japanese officials indicated readiness to address excessive currency volatility if necessary.

Meanwhile, international oil prices declined slightly and headed toward a second weekly loss. Brent futures dropped to $95.54 a barrel, and US West Texas Intermediate futures fell to $88.18 a barrel amid developments involving the US blockade of Iran.

The dollar index stood at 103.17, maintaining levels not seen since April 2025. Investors also monitored ongoing developments in global equity markets, particularly surrounding technology sector pressures.

stories.title: جادو ٹونے سے حکومتیں نہیں ملتیں، عظمیٰ بخاری کا سخت ردعمل
stories.summary:
پنجاب کی وزیر اطلاعات عظمیٰ بخاری کا کہنا ہے کہ نہ تو جادو ٹونے سے حکومتیں چلتی ہیں اور نہ ہی جھوٹ اور پروپیگنڈے سے حکومتیں گرتی ہیں۔ اپنے ایک بیان میں انہوں نے کہا کہ کچھ بے روزگار اور سیاسی یتیم نئے ٹھکانے تلاش کرنے کی خاطر ہاتھ پاؤں مار رہے ہیں لیکن پنجاب میں ترقی کا سفر تیزی سے جاری ہے۔

عظمیٰ بخاری کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز نے گڈ گورننس، شفافیت اور میرٹ کو پنجاب کا ماڈل بنا دیا ہے جو اب دوسرے صوبوں کے لیے ایک مثال بن چکا ہے۔ انہوں نے دعویٰ کیا کہ پچھلے دو سالوں میں جو کام مریم نواز نے کر دکھائے ہیں وہ ملکی تاریخ میں پہلے کبھی نہیں ہوئے اور جعلی بیانیے بنانے والے اب قصہ پارینہ بن چکے ہیں۔

صوبائی وزیر نے کہا کہ مریم نواز کو ٹارگٹ کرنے والے غیر اہم لوگ خود کو اہم بنانے کی کوشش کر رہے ہیں مگر ان کی کوئی دال نہیں گلنے والی کیونکہ عوام انہیں کھلے دل سے تسلیم کر چکے ہیں۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر بھی زور دیا کہ مردہ گھوڑے میں ہوا بھرنے کی اب کوئی بھی کوشش کامیاب نہیں ہو سکتی۔

stories.title: کراچی: چینی انجینئرز پر حملہ کرنے والے مجرم کو 48 سال قید
stories.summary:
کراچی کی انسداد دہشتگردی عدالت نے گل بائی کے قریب چینی انجینئرز کی گاڑی پر فائرنگ کے مقدمے کا فیصلہ سناتے ہوئے مرکزی ملزم داد بخش کو مجموعی طور پر 48 برس قید کی سزا سنا دی ہے۔ ڈپٹی پراسیکیوٹر جنرل کے مطابق ملزم نے اپنے ساتھیوں کے ہمراہ جولائی 2021 میں اس حملے کو انجام دیا تھا جس کے نتیجے میں ایک چینی انجینئر زخمی ہوا تھا۔

عدالت نے ملزم کو 7 لاکھ روپے جرمانہ ادا کرنے کا حکم دینے کے علاوہ ساڑے آٹھ لاکھ روپے زخمی غیر ملکی شہری کو معاوضے کے طور پر دینے کا بھی حکم جاری کیا۔ فیصلے میں کہا گیا کہ استغاثہ نے شواہد کی بنیاد پر یہ ثابت کیا کہ ملزم نے دانستہ طور پر چینی انجینئرز کی گاڑی کو نشانہ بنایا تھا۔

عدالت نے اپنے ریمارکس میں واضح کیا کہ غیر ملکی شہریوں پر حملہ ایک قومی اور بین الاقوامی اہمیت کا حامل معاملہ ہے۔ چینی انجینئرز دو طرفہ معاہدوں کے تحت ملک میں قومی اہمیت کے منصوبوں پر کام کر رہے ہیں اور اس نوعیت کے حملوں کا مقصد غیر ملکیوں کے خلاف نفرت پھیلانا، ملک میں بدامنی پیدا کرنا اور تشدد کو ہوا دینا ہے۔ عدالت نے مفرور ملزمان کے خلاف کارروائی فی الحال التوا میں رکھنے کا بھی کہا ہے۔

stories.title: Malaysian Palm Oil Futures Secure First Weekly Gain in Three Weeks
stories.summary:
Malaysian palm oil futures closed higher, securing their first weekly increase in three weeks. The benchmark contract for January delivery on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange rose 22 ringgit, or 0.5 percent, to settle at 4,462 ringgit ($1,093.09) per metric ton, resulting in a weekly gain of 4.79 percent.

Leading industry analysts meeting at the Indonesian Palm Oil Conference projected a price recovery in upcoming months. Production impacts stemming from an El Niño-induced drought are anticipated to affect output during the first quarter of 2027, particularly within top producer Indonesia.

Market enthusiasm was somewhat tempered by uncertainty regarding a new service fee introduced by Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia. Traders in Kuala Lumpur noted that participants are waiting for clarification on how this fee might affect the wider palm oil sector.

Palm oil prices traded in relation to broader edible oil markets, with Dalian's soyoil and palm oil contracts posting gains alongside Chicago Board of Trade soyoil futures. Additionally, a weaker Malaysian ringgit made the commodity more affordable for foreign buyers.

Crude oil futures experienced minor increases but were on track for a weekly decline. Weaker energy markets reduce the appeal of palm oil when used as a feedstock for biodiesel production.

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Suspends Local Government Elections Across Capital
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court suspended upcoming local government elections in the capital, placing the Election Commission of Pakistan's schedule on hold until the next hearing. Justice Umair Majeed Malik issued the interim relief during a hearing on a writ petition filed by Chaudhry Amjad Ali.

The petitioner challenged the ECP's October 21 order and election schedule for December 20, arguing that polls could not proceed until the legal status of constituency delimitations was properly resolved. The court issued notices to respondents, directing them to submit reports and comments by November 26.

Legal counsel for the petitioner argued that legislative changes between the Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Act of 2015 and the temporary Local Government Ordinance of 2026 created legal complications. The 2015 law established 125 union councils with nine wards each, whereas the 2026 ordinance introduced three town corporations and delimited union councils based on census blocks, raising the total count to 130.

After the temporary ordinance lapsed under Article 89 of the Constitution, the original 2015 law was revived. The petitioner contended that the ECP abruptly scheduled elections under the revived law without addressing required delimitations for the original union councils, wards, or metropolitan corporation structure.

The court observed that the arguments raised valid points requiring detailed consideration. Consequently, the bench halted the implementation of the election schedule and ECP order until the proceedings resume on November 26.

stories.title: Global Silver Demand Projected to Decline 5 Percent Amid High Prices
stories.summary:
Global demand for silver is on track to drop by 5 percent this year, settling at 1.08 billion troy ounces, according to a recent analysis by consultancy Metals Focus for the Silver Institute. This downturn is primarily driven by reduced spending on jewellery and lower consumption in solar cells, where soaring prices have prompted widespread material substitution. The market follows a dramatic prior year in 2025, during which prices surged to a record high of $121.60 per ounce in January before falling sharply by 59 percent to $50 an ounce.

The broader market environment has shifted due to anticipations of elevated interest rates, a stronger US dollar, and higher bond yields, all of which have cooled investment enthusiasm. Consequently, net exchange-traded product (ETP) flows have reversed, with projected outflows of 45 million ounces following massive inflows the previous year. Industrial demand overall is expected to contract by 3 percent, affected by lower-than-anticipated photovoltaic installations, particularly in China. Meanwhile, consumer segments face even steeper declines, with jewellery and silverware demand forecast to fall by 22 percent and 17 percent, respectively, exacerbated by higher costs and weakened rural spending in India.

Total supply is expected to decrease by 3 percent to 1.04 billion troy ounces, with mine production dipping slightly to 834 million ounces while recycling rises by 6 percent to 210 million ounces. The physical market balance, excluding ETP movements, is expected to show a smaller surplus of 10 million ounces compared to deep deficits in prior years. Despite these adjustments, retail interest has cooled significantly since March following the earlier price spikes, pointing to subdued bar and coin demand globally.

This contraction matters as it marks a significant cooling period for a critical industrial and precious metal following unprecedented speculative and retail rallies. The transition highlights how extreme price volatility can permanently alter industrial manufacturing choices through substitution, while broader macroeconomic shifts continue to reshape investor sentiment and market liquidity across international trading hubs.

stories.title: Islamabad Prepares to Transition into Pakistan's First Cashless City
stories.summary:
Islamabad is scheduled to become Pakistan's first fully cashless city by December 31, with all local merchants and government offices transitioning to digital payment methods. Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry announced the initiative during a Friday meeting in the capital, emphasizing the necessity of stakeholder cooperation to ensure a smooth rollout. Under the new rules, cash transactions will be prohibited across all Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT) and Capital Development Authority (CDA) departments starting November 30.

To meet the end-of-year deadline for local businesses, authorities have already connected approximately 26,000 merchants to the digital system. Officials intend to extend digital payment infrastructure to all levels of commerce, ranging from major business establishments down to street vendors. This municipal push builds upon broader national efforts under the Prime Minister's Cashless Pakistan initiative, which has already seen active digital merchants nationwide quadruple to 2.03 million and total digital transaction volumes double over the past year.

Parallel discussions involving the Ministry of Finance and the State Bank of Pakistan have focused on expanding the Raast digital payment ecosystem. Measures include processing the Raast QR Merchant Discount Rate scheme, integrating QR codes onto utility bills exceeding 45 million accounts, and equipping National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) centers with digital payment capabilities. Furthermore, all payments through Asaan Assignment Accounts transitioned to the Raast system beginning November 16.

This municipal digitization serves as a pilot and accelerator for Pakistan's wider national economy, aiming to increase financial transparency and reduce reliance on physical currency. By setting strict operational deadlines for government agencies and businesses alike, the government hopes to institutionalize digital transactions as the standard across public services and commercial trade.

stories.title: Weekly Inflation Drops by 0.46 Percent Driven by Lower Fuel Prices
stories.summary:
Pakistan's weekly inflation experienced a downward adjustment of 0.46 percent for the week ending November 12, 2026, primarily due to substantial decreases in petroleum costs. According to the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, the Sensitive Price Indicator for combined consumers dropped to 372.90 points from 374.61 points the previous week, though it still reflects an 11.21 percent increase on an annual basis. The impact varied across income brackets, with the lowest-income group seeing a modest 0.03 percent increase, while higher-income brackets experienced declines ranging from 0.09 percent to 0.68 percent.

During the monitoring period, prices for 19 out of 51 tracked items rose, while 9 items decreased and 23 remained unchanged. Petrol registered the most significant week-on-week decline at 7.42 percent, closely followed by diesel dropping 6.10 percent. Additional weekly price reductions were noted for food items such as onions, bananas, gur, and sugar. Conversely, items experiencing the highest weekly increases included tomatoes up 12.06 percent, eggs up 5.98 percent, and potatoes up 2.42 percent.

When evaluated on a year-on-year basis, liquefied petroleum gas recorded the steepest surge at 111.35 percent, followed by sharp annual increases in tomatoes, quarterly electricity charges, and wheat flour. Conversely, potatoes registered the largest annual price drop at 36.41 percent, alongside notable yearly declines for sugar, eggs, and various pulses. In a separate development, the Islamabad Capital Territory Police arrested a constable for allegedly taking a bribe to help a female beggar escape custody, highlighting ongoing anti-corruption enforcement within the department.

These weekly economic figures matter because they offer an immediate gauge of cost-of-living fluctuations for ordinary citizens, heavily influenced by global commodity adjustments like petroleum. While fuel price cuts offer temporary relief to household budgets, persistent annual increases in essential food and utility items continue to present financial challenges across different income segments.

stories.title: Indian Rupee Snaps Winning Streak Amid Higher Oil and Hawkish Fed
stories.summary:
The Indian rupee halted its recent recovery path, closing lower at 94.24 against the US dollar, which marks a 0.2 percent daily decline and a 0.3 percent drop for the week. The currency's retreat was driven by rising global crude oil prices and mounting expectations that the US Federal Reserve will adopt a more aggressive monetary policy stance. These adverse external pressures counteracted the positive momentum generated by robust foreign portfolio inflows earlier in the period.

Foreign investors poured over $8 billion into Indian equities during November alone, alongside an additional $800 million into local debt markets, propelling the rupee to a six-month high prior to the late-week reversal. Market analysts note that the Reserve Bank of India has likely utilized periods of currency strength to accumulate foreign exchange reserves. Meanwhile, rising US Treasury yields—with the two-year yield hitting a one-month peak—reflect investor speculation regarding a potential 50-basis-point rate increase by the Federal Reserve next month.

The confluence of stronger US bond yields and renewed concerns over energy costs weighed heavily on domestic financial markets, pushing the benchmark Nifty 50 lower and causing the 10-year government bond yield to climb more than 6 basis points to 7.31 percent. Compounding these pressures, newly released government data revealed that India's merchandise trade deficit for October widened to a one-year high, adding fundamental strain to the currency.

This currency movement underscores India's ongoing vulnerability to shifting global macroeconomic conditions, particularly US monetary policy shifts and international energy price volatility. Despite healthy capital inflows that helped cushion the rupee from recent near-record lows, external headwinds continue to limit the scope for sustained currency appreciation.

stories.title: Indian Shares Drop as Oil Prices and Inflation Weigh Heavily
stories.summary:
Indian benchmark indices fell on Friday, reducing their weekly gains due to rising crude prices and mounting inflationary pressures that dampened investor sentiment. Despite support from foreign institutional inflows, ongoing global market turbulence and Middle East conflict headwinds impacted the nascent economic recovery.

Retail inflation for October exceeded the upper limit of the Reserve Bank of India's 2% to 6% tolerance range, raising expectations for upcoming monetary tightening. Analysts noted that higher inflation leads to increased bond yields and tighter liquidity, placing valuation pressure on rate-sensitive sectors such as banking, real estate, autos, and infrastructure.

On the session, the Nifty 50 dropped 0.61% to 25,144.3 and the Sensex declined 0.39% to 81,592.45. Financial and banking stocks fell between 0.7% and 0.8%, pulling benchmarks down. However, over the course of the week, the Nifty 50 and Sensex managed to post increases of 0.5% and 0.7%, respectively.

Equities also found backing from approximately $8 billion in foreign inflows during November, marking the highest monthly total since December 2020. Market observers warn that equities could experience near-term volatility as investors reprice policy expectations, though domestic growth and corporate earnings remain resilient.

stories.title: Truck and Bus Collision in Assam Leaves At Least 23 Dead
stories.summary:
At least 23 people were killed and several others injured on Friday when a container truck collided with a bus in India's northeastern state of Assam. The fatal accident occurred on a highway situated near Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its population of one-horned rhinoceroses. Golaghat district superintendent of police, Swapnaneel Deka, confirmed the initial death toll and stated that seven injured individuals had been transferred to a hospital, with expectations that the number of fatalities could rise further.

According to local authorities, the bus was carrying approximately 30 passengers and traveling toward a neighboring district when the crash happened. The driver of the container truck also sustained injuries in the collision. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma expressed profound distress over the tragedy in a public post on X, confirming that a senior cabinet minister was dispatched directly to the accident site to oversee immediate relief operations and ensure the injured receive prompt medical attention.

The scale of the disaster has deeply impacted the local community and state leadership, prompting swift emergency responses. Kaziranga National Park, typically visited for its rich wildlife heritage, became the backdrop for one of the deadliest highway accidents in the region in recent memory. Authorities remain focused on medical treatment for the survivors and investigating the exact circumstances that led to the devastating collision.

Key figures involved in the response include District Superintendent Swapnaneel Deka and Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, who mobilized state resources following the incident. As rescue operations conclude and medical teams treat the wounded, families of the victims mourn the sudden loss. The tragedy highlights ongoing concerns regarding highway safety in the region.

stories.title: Pakistan Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia at UNSC Session
stories.summary:
Pakistan has strongly condemned recent Houthi terrorist attacks directed at Saudi Arabia while expressing total support for Yemen's sovereignty, independence, and territorial integrity. Speaking at a United Nations Security Council session on Friday, Ambassador Syed Haider Shah, Pakistan's Permanent Representative to the UN, demanded an immediate and unconditional halt to the aggression against the kingdom.

The diplomatic statements coincided with the UN Security Council's adoption of a resolution to renew sanctions established under resolution 2140 from 2014 and extend the mandate of the supporting Panel of Experts. Ambassador Shah praised the resolution and commended the United Kingdom for its constructive role as penholder during negotiations, emphasizing that holding accountable those who threaten Yemen's security is vital for lasting peace.

The security situation has escalated following claims by the Houthi movement that they targeted a pumping station on the Saudi East-West oil pipeline, an oil facility in Yanbu, and an Aramco building in Riyadh. The Saudi-led military coalition subsequently confirmed intercepting and destroying two drones launched by the group, one over the Riyadh region and another in the Eastern Province. Ambassador Shah reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's legitimate right to defend its territory under the UN Charter.

Pakistan and Saudi Arabia have steadily strengthened their bilateral security ties, recently signing a defense agreement in September 2025. Furthermore, in August 2026, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye established the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, a trilateral pact declaring that an assault on any member nation is considered an attack against all three allies.

stories.title: Sophie Cunningham Discusses 2026 WNBA Performance and Future Goals
stories.summary:
Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham recently discussed her 2026 WNBA season during a film session on her podcast, No Hesitation, alongside co-host and trainer Drew Hanlen. During the episode, the 28-year-old athlete described her conference as a challenging "pit" and expressed her desire to expand her offensive capabilities moving into free agency and the 2027 season.

Throughout 43 regular-season games averaging 22.2 minutes, Cunningham posted averages of 7.9 points, 2.3 rebounds, and 1.2 assists, while shooting 46.0% from the field and 41.9% from beyond the arc. Despite maintaining a reliable perimeter presence off the bench, she admitted she is unsatisfied with her current performance and wants to explore more of her potential.

Hanlen highlighted her catch-and-shoot proficiency, noting she converted 65 of 151 attempts, as a key asset that must remain a central focus. Both discussed the need for Cunningham to improve her off-ball movement, such as utilizing pin-down screens and relocating around the perimeter to generate additional scoring chances for herself and teammates like Caitlin Clark and Kelsey Mitchell.

Cunningham enters the offseason as an unrestricted free agent following a one-year contract. Refining her offensive movement and defensive intensity are viewed as crucial steps to increase her value to the Indiana Fever or another franchise for the 2027 campaign.

stories.title: Nine-Month-Old Baby Dies of Hypothermia in Flooded Gaza Tent
stories.summary:
A nine-month-old Palestinian baby named Kinan Ahmed Raqiq died of hypothermia on Thursday after severe weather and flooding struck displacement camps in the Gaza Strip. The infant's father and a treating doctor confirmed that the child succumbed to the extreme cold inside his family's tent in Khan Yunis.

The father stated that he woke up to find his son's skin had turned blue and rushed him to Nasser Hospital, where the baby was pronounced dead. Heavy rains from the previous week had already flooded tens of thousands of tents across Gaza, where nearly the entire population has faced displacement due to ongoing conflict.

UNICEF spokesperson James Elder warned that the severe flooding is merely the beginning of the cold season, noting that unprecedented rain and cold arrive weeks ahead of traditional winter weather. According to the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, storms had affected 26,000 households by November 8.

While Israel and Hamas declared a ceasefire on October 10, 2025, military strikes have continued. In response to the crisis, President Donald Trump's Board of Peace criticized Israel for failing to adequately prepare for cold weather conditions and urged authorities to permit more humanitarian supplies into the territory.

stories.title: Mari Energies Announces Copper-Gold Discovery in Balochistan's Chagai
stories.summary:
Mari Energies Limited announced a notable copper-gold discovery at its East Siah Diq exploration target in Balochistan's Chagai district, managed through its subsidiary, Mari Minerals. The company submitted a formal notification regarding the finding to the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Friday.

The discovery site is situated approximately 50 kilometers east of the Reko Diq copper-gold mine development project and 25 kilometers northwest of Nokkundi in the Koh-i-Sultan area. Mari Minerals completed roughly 25,000 meters of exploration drilling across two phases at the ESD-1 target, utilizing vertical drill holes extending down to 500 meters.

Geochemical assays from Phase 1A indicated the presence of copper-gold mineralization across intersected bedrock beneath approximately 100 meters of overburden sediments, covering an area of around 1.4 square kilometers. SGS Pakistan processed and analyzed the samples, while the company applied standard quality assurance protocols using reference materials from Australia.

Mari Energies cautioned that the find cannot yet be classified as a formal mineral resource or mineable reserve, as its true scale and economic viability will rely on further drilling and technical evaluations. Phase 1B assaying is currently underway and anticipated to finish in the first quarter of 2027.

stories.title: ECP Issues Ultimatum to PMO Over Delayed Cantonment Board Elections
stories.summary:
The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) has given the Prime Minister’s Office a two-week deadline to submit a formal written request for holding local government elections in cantonment boards. During a hearing led by Chief Election Commissioner Sikandar Sultan Raja on November 10, a five-member bench warned that the commission will be forced to issue appropriate orders if the federal government fails to respond. The dispute centers on 42 cantonment boards nationwide where local government terms expired on April 11, 2026, making elections legally due by August 8 under the Elections Act, 2017.

Despite completing preliminary steps such as ward delimitations by April 20 and holding consultative meetings with the Ministry of Defence and the Military Lands and Cantonments Department (ML&CD), the ECP has faced continuous delays. The commission previously sent multiple letters, reminders, and even a direct request from the Chief Election Commissioner to the prime minister in July. During the recent hearing, Ministry of Defence legal adviser Falak Naaz and ML&CD Additional Director General Khalil Ahmad Rana confirmed that the ministry is fully prepared to conduct the polls but noted that the required summary remains pending with the PMO without a response from the federal government.

The ECP emphasized that Articles 140-A and 219(d) of the Constitution obligate the commission to hold local government elections across provinces, Islamabad, and cantonment boards. The military authorities previously dissolved 44 cantonment boards on November 11, 2025, upon completing their four-year tenure, setting up caretaker administrations. The current stalemate highlights a breakdown in administrative coordination between the executive branch and election regulators regarding grassroots democracy.

This ongoing delay affects local governance in historic military bases administered under the Cantonments Act 1924. With the ECP's latest ultimatum, the federal government must decide whether to formally greenlight the electoral process or face binding orders from the country's top election watchdog to ensure constitutional mandates are met.

stories.title: Islamabad Set to Become Pakistan's First Fully Cashless City by Year-End
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government has established a December 31 deadline to transition the federal capital into the country's first fully cashless city. The decision was formalized during a meeting on the Cashless Capital project chaired by State Minister for Interior Tallal Chaudry in Islamabad on Friday. Ministry officials stated that the implementation is progressing rapidly under instructions from Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi.

Under the new directives, no cash payments will be accepted across any department of the Islamabad Capital Territory administration and the Capital Development Authority after November 30. Furthermore, authorities aim to integrate all local merchants into the digital payment system by the end of December. State Minister Chaudhry noted that 26,000 merchants in Islamabad are already connected to digital payment infrastructure, which will span from street vendors to major business centers.

Officials emphasized that the transition to digital payments aims to enhance financial transparency, tax monitoring, and transaction efficiency. Capital Development Authority Chairman Sohail Ashraf and representatives from the banking sector attended the meeting, with banking officials offering full cooperation for the initiative's success. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has repeatedly highlighted the necessity of nationwide digital transaction systems to bring transparency to the broader economy.

Government authorities are actively preparing a clear roadmap and time-bound targets to establish a fully digital payments system across Pakistan. Work on digitizing payments within federal and provincial government institutions is advancing quickly, with most institutions projected to complete their transition by December 2026. The promotion of a cashless economy remains a primary objective for the current administration as part of broader financial reforms.

stories.title: National Resources Limited Discovers Copper and Gold at Eight Balochistan Sites
stories.summary:
Mining firm National Resources Limited has uncovered significant copper and gold reserves across eight locations in the Chagai district of Balochistan. The discoveries come after nearly 25,000 metres of drilling produced very promising results, paving the way for the company's initial assessment of mineral resources in the region. National Resources Limited Chairman Muhammad Ali Tabba revealed the findings during the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026.

Specific findings from a drill hole detailed a 295-metre zone holding 0.43 per cent copper and 0.13 grams of gold per tonne, which included a denser 132-metre segment containing 0.83 per cent copper. These finds span a 5.6 square kilometre territory in Darigwan, connecting directly to previous finds at the Tang Kaur copper and gold location. Further evaluation under exploration licence EL214 is anticipated to clarify the total extent of the mineral deposits once work and official resource assessments conclude.

National Resources Limited operates as a joint venture among Fatima Fertilisers, Liberty Mills, and Lucky Cement Ltd, holding five distinct exploration licences in Balochistan that cover copper-gold, lead-zinc, and antimony projects. The company intends to launch environmental, hydrogeological, metallurgical, and geotechnical studies in 2027 to finalize a bankable feasibility study by the decade's end. Tabba reiterated a previously committed $100 million investment for mineral exploration in Pakistan, welcoming domestic and international stakeholders to participate.

Although an independent consultant prepared preliminary resource estimates, the company is delaying public release until international reporting requirements are fully met. Additionally, National Resources Limited has teamed up with the Lahore University of Management Sciences to build a predictive artificial intelligence model for faster exploration. Alongside technical progress, the company established the Chagai Foundation to foster education and community advancement, ensuring local populations benefit directly from regional mineral wealth.

stories.title: PTA Advises Citizens on Biometric Security and Courier Fraud
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority has issued a public warning advising citizens to exercise caution when sharing biometric information for new SIM cards and telecom services. Consumers should ensure fingerprints are given only at authorised customer service centres, franchises, or approved sales outlets of mobile network operators. Additionally, citizens are encouraged to keep a record of the network operator, outlet address, and the exact purpose of biometric collection to protect personal data from misuse.

In a separate advisory, the authority cautioned the public against a rising form of fraud involving criminals impersonating courier company representatives. These scammers contact individuals about incoming parcel deliveries and trick them into disclosing sensitive details, including one-time passwords. The PTA stressed that citizens must never share OTPs with unknown callers or unauthorized entities claiming to represent courier services or other organizations.

These public awareness initiatives are designed to help prevent identity theft, financial fraud, and the unauthorized use of citizens' sensitive information. The regulatory body continues to urge heightened vigilance across Pakistan as new methods of digital and telecom deception emerge. Consumers are reminded to verify the legitimacy of any requests for personal data before complying.

By promoting these safety measures, the PTA aims to safeguard personal privacy and reduce vulnerability to criminal schemes. Citizens can protect themselves by remaining alert and adhering strictly to official security guidelines provided by regulatory authorities.

stories.title: اسلام آباد ہائی کورٹ نے دارالحکومت میں بلدیاتی انتخابات کا شیڈول معطل کر دیا
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد ہائی کورٹ نے وفاقی دارالحکومت میں بلدیاتی انتخابات کے انعقاد کا شیڈول معطل کرتے ہوئے حکمِ امتناع جاری کر دیا ہے۔ عدالت نے اس حوالے سے الیکشن کمیشن کی جانب سے اکیس اکتوبر کو جاری کیا جانے والا نوٹی فکیشن بھی معطل کر دیا ہے۔ جسٹس عمیر مجید ملک نے حکمِ امتناع جاری کرتے ہوئے الیکشن کمیشن کو باضابطہ نوٹس جاری کر دیا ہے اور اکیس نومبر تک جواب طلب کیا ہے۔

اس فیصلے سے قبل اسلام آباد میں بلدیاتی انتخابات کے لیے کاغذاتِ نامزدگی جمع کرانے کا مرحلہ کامیابی کے ساتھ مکمل ہو چکا تھا۔ دارالحکومت میں جنرل کونسلر کی گیارہ سو پچیس نشستوں کے لیے مجموعی طور پر تین ہزار پانچ سو پانچ امیدواروں نے اپنے کاغذاتِ نامزدگی جمع کرائے تھے۔ انتخابی عمل کے لیے کل چھ ہزار پانچ سو اڑسٹھ کاغذاتِ نامزدگی جاری کیے گئے تھے، جن میں جنرل کونسلر کی نشستوں پر حصہ لینے کے لیے ایک سو دس خواتین امیدوار بھی شامل تھیں جنہوں نے اپنے کاغذات جمع کرائے۔

واضح رہے کہ اسلام آباد میں بلدیاتی اداروں کی آئینی مدت فروری دو ہزار اکیس میں ہی ختم ہو چکی تھی۔ تقریباً ساڑھے پانچ سال کے طویل انتظار کے بعد دارالحکومت میں بیس دسمبر کو پولنگ کا شیڈول طے کیا گیا تھا جس پر اب عدالتی حکم کے باعث عارضی روک لگ گئی ہے۔ اس معاملے کی آئندہ سماعت چھبیس نومبر کو ہوگی جس میں الیکشن کمیشن کو اپنا جواب جمع کرانا ہوگا۔

stories.title: پاکستان کی معدنی دولت کو کارآمد بنانا اجتماعی قومی مقصد ہے، فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر
stories.summary:
فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر نے کہا ہے کہ پاکستان کی وسیع معدنی دولت کو مؤثر طریقے سے کارآمد بنانا ہم سب کا ایک اجتماعی قومی مقصد ہے۔ اسلام آباد میں منعقدہ منرلز فورم سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ ہمارا ہدف صرف خام مال کو برآمد کرنا نہیں ہونا چاہیے، بلکہ اس کے ساتھ ساتھ ریفائننگ اور مینوفیکچرنگ تک پوری ویلیو چین کو مکمل طور پر تیار کرنا ہے۔

فیلڈ مارشل نے کہا کہ ہم اس قسم کی طویل مدتی شراکت داری کو پروان چڑھانا چاہتے ہیں جو پاکستان اور اس کے تمام شراکت داروں کے لیے پائیدار معاشی قدر پیدا کرنے کا باعث بنے۔ انہوں نے اس امر پر بھی روشنی ڈ डाली کہ معدنی ترقی کا یہ عمل ایسا ہونا چاہیے جس سے مقامی آبادیوں کو براہ راست فائدہ پہنچے، اور معدنیات سے مالا مال علاقوں کے باسیوں کی زندگیوں میں واضح اور ٹھوس بہتری نظر آنی چاہیے۔

انہوں نے پاکستانی قوم کی تعریف کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ یہاں کے لوگ انتہائی محنتی، دلیر اور پُرعزم ہیں جو اپنے خوابوں کو حقیقت میں بدلنے کی بھرپور صلاحیت رکھتے ہیں۔ ہمارے قدرتی وسائل ہمیں بہترین مواقع فراہم کرتے ہیں، جبکہ اصل نتائج کے حصول کے لیے ہمارے عوام ہی طاقت اور عزم کا اصل سرچشمہ ہیں۔

فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر نے مزید کہا کہ اب وقت آ گیا ہے کہ ہم محض صلاحیت سے نکل کر پیداوار کی طرف، وعدوں سے آگے بڑھ کر عملی اقدامات کی طرف، اور خام برآمدات کے بجائے ویلیو ایڈڈ گروتھ کی سمت قدم بڑھائیں۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ کان کنی کے پورے ماحولیاتی نظام کی سیکیورٹی کو ہر صورت یقینی بنانے کے لیے مسلسل اقدامات کیے جا رہے ہیں اور آئندہ بھی جاری رہیں گے۔

stories.title: پیٹ کمنز نے عثمان خواجہ کے سینڈ پیپر سکینڈل کے دعوے کو مسترد کر دیا
stories.summary:
آسٹریلیا کے ٹیسٹ کپتان پیٹ کمنز نے عثمان خواجہ کی سوانح عمری میں کیے گئے اس دعوے کو سراسر بے بنیاد قرار دیا ہے کہ پوری آسٹریلوی ٹیم 2018 کے سینڈ پیپر سکینڈل سے آگاہ تھی۔ سڈنی میں پریس کانفرنس کرتے ہوئے کمنز نے واضح کیا کہ انہیں اس واقعے کا کوئی علم نہیں تھا اور عثمان کا یہ کہنا کہ سب جانتے تھے، سو فیصد غلط ہے۔ یہ سکینڈل 2018 میں جنوبی افریقہ کے خلاف کیپ ٹاؤن ٹیسٹ میں سامنے آیا تھا جب کیمرون بینکرافٹ کو گیند کی حالت تبدیل کرتے ہوئے پکڑا گیا تھا۔

اس واقعے کے نتیجے میں اس وقت کے کپتان اسٹیو سمتھ اور نائب کپتان ڈیوڈ وارنر کو قیادت سے ہٹایا گیا تھا اور طویل پابندیوں کا سامنا کرنا پڑا تھا، جبکہ ہیڈ کوچ ڈیرن لیہمن نے بھی استعفیٰ دے دیا تھا۔ کمنز نے کہا کہ وہ عثمان خواجہ کے دوست ہیں لیکن کتاب میں کی گئی باتیں آسٹریلوی کرکٹ اور افراد کی ساکھ کے حوالے سے غیر سنجیدہ رویے کی عکاس ہیں۔

دوسری جانب سابق آسٹریلوی اوپنر ڈیوڈ وارنر نے انسٹاگرام پر ایک ویڈیو میں عثمان خواجہ کی بھرپور حمایت کی اور دعویٰ کیا کہ اس وقت کی تحقیقات کا عمل جلد بازی اور ناقص انداز میں کیا گیا تھا۔ وارنر نے مؤقف اپنایا کہ اس معاملے میں پوری ٹیم کو اجتماعی ذمہ داری قبول کرنی چاہیے تھی۔

عثمان خواجہ نے جنوری میں اپنی بین الاقوامی کرکٹ سے ریٹائرمنٹ لی تھی اور وہ اپنے انکشافات کے بعد سے عالمی میڈیا کی توجہ کا مرکز بنے ہوئے ہیں۔ کمنز، مچل سٹارک، جوش ہیزل ووڈ اور نیتھن لیون وہ چار بولرز ہیں جو اس وقت بھی ٹیم کا حصہ ہیں اور وہ مسلسل اس منصوبے سے لاعلمی کا اظہار کرتے آئے ہیں۔

stories.title: Security Forces Neutralize 74 India-Backed Terrorists in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan
stories.summary:
Pakistani security forces have successfully eliminated at least 74 India-backed terrorists during a series of intelligence-based operations conducted across Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces. According to the Inter-Services Public Relations, the military wing, these coordinated counterterrorism actions targeted militant hideouts and infrastructure in multiple volatile districts.

In the Kurram area of Quetta district, troops launched an area sanitisation operation on November 3 against militants associated with Fitna al-Khawarij and Fitna al-Hindustan. Following intense engagements, security forces neutralized 31 insurgents and recovered significant caches of weapons, ammunition, and explosives from their hideouts.

Concurrently, operations were expanded into the Mir Ali and Orakzai regions of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa over a 48-hour period. Fierce exchanges of fire resulted in the deaths of 35 terrorists in Mir Ali and 8 in Orakzai. Troops also seized large quantities of homemade explosives and improvised explosive devices, preempting planned attacks.

The military stated that sanitisation efforts remain ongoing to clear out remaining elements. These actions are part of the broader Azm-e-Istehkam counterterrorism campaign aimed at eradicating foreign-sponsored violence, which has heavily concentrated in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan since 2021.

stories.title: Sophie Cunningham Recalls Stephen A. Smith's Lakers Remarks
stories.summary:
WNBA player Sophie Cunningham recently addressed the Los Angeles Lakers' impressive start to the 2026-27 NBA season while criticizing skeptics and ESPN commentator Stephen A. Smith. Discussing the team's early success, Cunningham recalled a past podcast interview with NBA trainer Drew Hanlen and referenced an old segment by Smith questioning whether a team built around white players could win a championship.

Cunningham expressed amusement at the initial doubts surrounding the roster, noting that the Lakers have effectively silenced critics with their strong on-court performance. As an acknowledged fan of Slovenian star Luka Dončić, she praised his prolific scoring and high-level play, which has elevated the team near the top of the Western Conference standings.

Reflecting on the competitive mindset of professional athletes, Cunningham emphasized that high-level competitors thrive when told they cannot succeed, using outside doubt as fuel to prove detractors wrong. The Lakers' strong early run has positioned them as formidable contenders in the current NBA season.

Despite past skepticism from analysts regarding roster construction, the team's recent victories have validated their competitive potential. Cunningham's remarks highlight the ongoing narrative surrounding the franchise's surprising and dominant start to the year.

stories.title: Beardman and Marsh Drive Australia to Victory Over England
stories.summary:
Mahli Beardman recorded remarkable debut figures of 6-24 before Mitchell Marsh scored a rapid half-century to lead Australia to a seven-wicket win over England in the first ODI at Perth Stadium on Friday. After Marsh won the toss and elected to bowl, 21-year-old Beardman tore through the England batting lineup, causing the visitors to collapse and get bowled out for 131 in 33.4 overs.

England openers Ben Duckett and Tom Banton advanced the score to 24 before Duckett edged Spencer Johnson to slip, triggering a collapse of 7-41. Aside from a brief partnership featuring Will Jacks and an unbeaten 29 from Gus Atkinson, the English batsmen struggled against the seam and swing of Beardman and Johnson, with Johnson finishing with 3-42.

Chasing the modest target, Australia suffered an early setback when Atkinson bowled Travis Head with the first ball of the innings. However, Marsh launched an aggressive counterattack, striking a 29-ball fifty that included four boundaries and four sixes to secure the victory alongside contributions from Cooper Connolly, Josh Inglis, and Matt Renshaw.

England captain Harry Brook acknowledged that his team failed to execute their skills effectively on the drop-in pitch at Optus Stadium. The three-match series will continue on Sunday with the second fixture scheduled in Adelaide.

stories.title: Pakistan Launches Nationwide Schools Hockey League to Revive National Talent
stories.summary:
Pakistan has initiated a nationwide Schools Hockey League aimed at uncovering young talent and revitalizing the country's historic standing in international hockey. The official launch took place at the Naseer Bunda Hockey Stadium in Islamabad, featuring an opening match where the Islamabad Model College for Girls, Tarlai, defeated the Islamabad Model College for Girls, G-6/1-4 by a score of 2-0 before an audience of students. 

The initiative was inaugurated by Mohyuddin Wani, president of the Pakistan Hockey Federation (PHF) and secretary of the Ministry of Inter-Provincial Coordination, alongside Dr Ehtesham Anwar, chief coordinator to the PHF president, and the nation's Dutch head coach, Herman Kruis. Organisers have rolled out the league simultaneously across Islamabad, all four provinces, Azad Jammu and Kashmir, and Gilgit-Baltistan, ensuring equal participation opportunities for both male and female athletes. 

As part of the reward structure, 100 exceptional boys and 100 outstanding girls will be chosen for specialized training camps. Furthermore, members of the top three boys' and girls' teams will receive one-year scholarships, while the overall winning team will secure an overseas tour to acquire vital international competition experience. 

Historically, Pakistan has claimed four Hockey World Cups and three Olympic gold medals, but the nation has faced difficulties maintaining its elite status among global competitors. Officials expect this grassroots effort to establish a reliable pathway for young athletes to advance into national squads while encouraging physical fitness, discipline, teamwork, and sportsmanship.

stories.title: Aadam Syed Holds Narrow Lead at 30th CNS Open Golf Championship
stories.summary:
Aadam Syed captured a slender one-stroke advantage after completing two rounds at the 30th Chief of the Naval Staff Open Golf Championship 2026. Taking place at the Karachi Golf Club, Syed recorded back-to-back rounds of 69 to arrive at a gross total of 138. Close behind him is Matloob Ahmad, who secured a 36-hole total of 139 following rounds of 70 and 69.

Further down the leaderboard, Arshad Rasheed and Hamza Taimur Amin share third position at 142. Rasheed followed his initial 70 with a 72, whereas Amin dropped from a first-round 69 to a 73. Muhammad Naeem secured fifth place with a total of 143 after recovering from a 75 with a round of 68, which is the lowest of the tournament so far. Additionally, a three-way tie for sixth place at 145 involves Muddasir Iqbal, Muhammad Munir, and Waheed Baloch. The 36-hole cut was established at 157, resulting in the elimination of any competitors registering a gross total of 158 or higher.

In the amateur men's division, Waleed Bilal established a three-stroke lead after finishing Friday's action with a 145 total, following scores of 68 and 77. Syed Shayal moved into second place with a score of 148 after carding a 70, sitting two strokes ahead of Abdullah Ansar Raja in third at 150. Syed Musa Hussaini and Muhammad Hassan Shahid are tied for fourth at 152, while Muhammad Arslan occupies sixth position at 154.

This tournament matters greatly for the competitors as they battle through the middle stages toward the final stretch. Syed aims to protect his minimal cushion over the remaining two rounds. Meanwhile, players eliminated by the cut miss out on the chance to contest the tournament's conclusion.

stories.title: Pat Cummins Denies Knowledge of 2018 Ball-Tampering Plot
stories.summary:
Australian cricket captain Pat Cummins stated that Usman Khawaja was completely wrong in his new autobiography by claiming the entire team knew about the 2018 ball-tampering scandal in South Africa. The controversy resurfaced after Khawaja alleged in his book that players, including Cummins, were aware of the plan to use sandpaper on the ball during the Cape Town Test and a previous match in Port Elizabeth.

David Warner strongly supported Khawaja's version of events and criticized Cummins for throwing Khawaja under the bus during a lengthy press conference. Cummins firmly denied any prior knowledge of the sandpaper plot, reiterating public denials he and fellow bowlers Mitchell Starc, Josh Hazlewood, and Nathan Lyon previously made in 2021. Former coach Darren Lehmann and batting coach Graeme Hick also denied knowing about the incident.

Cummins expressed disappointment that Khawaja raised the allegations casually eight years later, arguing that the claims damage reputations and affect Australian cricket broadly. While Cummins disputed Khawaja's claim about a dressing-room conversation urging collective responsibility, he admitted that the team culture in 2018 featured an unwanted win-at-all-costs mentality that he has since worked to change.

Cricket Australia has confirmed it will not reopen an investigation into the matter, and chairman David Boon assured Cummins that his position as captain remains secure. Meanwhile, Warner vowed to continue speaking out until what he considers the complete truth comes to light.

stories.title: Detention Order of PTI Lahore President Mian Usman Akram Withdrawn
stories.summary:
The deputy commissioner of Lahore, Capt. (Retd.) Muhammad Ali Ijaz, has withdrawn the detention order for Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) Lahore President Mian Usman Akram. This update was officially communicated through a report submitted to the Lahore High Court by a representative of the deputy commissioner. Justice Ali Zia Bajwa is set to hear the petition that initially challenged the detention, which was filed by Usman's wife, Kulsoom Usman, to secure his release. 

Mian Usman Akram had been held in jail for the past two months under Section 3 of the Maintenance of Public Order (MPO) Ordinance. His release follows closely behind the liberation of Noreen Khan Niazi and Uzma Khan, sisters of PTI founder Imran Khan, who were released from Kot Lakhpat Jail a day prior. The two sisters had been detained since September 21 under the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance of 1960, also by order of the Lahore deputy commissioner. 

During her detention, Noreen Niazi had experienced health complications on October 29. According to her lawyer, Rana Mudassar Umar, she was transferred from prison to the Punjab Institute of Cardiology after reporting chest pain, where she underwent initial medical examinations. 

Separately, the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) issued a public awareness message advising citizens to remain vigilant regarding their biometric data. The authority cautioned consumers to ensure that their fingerprints for acquiring new SIM cards or telecommunication services are only submitted at authorized customer service centers, franchises, or approved sales outlets.

stories.title: Australia Crushes England in Opening ODI After Mahli Beardman's Debut
stories.summary:
Australia secured a dominant seven-wicket victory over England in the first ODI of the three-match series in Perth on Friday. After Australian captain Mitchell Marsh won the toss and elected to bowl, 21-year-old debutant Mahli Beardman recorded the best ODI bowling figures by an Australian on debut, taking 6-24. Beardman tore through England's upper order with pace and aggression, while left-armer Spencer Johnson supported with 3-42 as the visitors were bowled out for 131 in 33.4 overs. 

England's innings began with openers Ben Duckett and Tom Banton reaching 24 runs before a collapse saw them lose 7-41. Gus Atkinson top-scored for England with an unbeaten 29 off 32 balls, aided by Will Jacks who contributed 25 runs, helping the team avoid a total score below 100. England captain Harry Brook noted that his team failed to properly execute their skills or adapt to the drop-in pitch at Optus Stadium against a disciplined Australian bowling attack. 

In response, Australia suffered an immediate setback when Atkinson bowled Travis Head with the first ball of the innings. However, Mitchell Marsh quickly shifted momentum by smashing an unbeaten 50 off 29 balls, featuring four boundaries and four sixes. Cooper Connolly added 27 runs, while Josh Inglis with 23 and Matt Renshaw with 26 successfully guided Australia to the target. 

The low-key start to the series took place amidst significant media attention surrounding the Sandpapergate ball-tampering scandal, which was reignited by the launch of former Australian opener Usman Khawaja’s autobiography. The two teams are scheduled to travel to Adelaide for the second match of the series on Sunday. 

In an unrelated public announcement, the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) urged citizens to exercise caution when providing fingerprints for new SIM cards and telecom services. The authority advised that biometric information should only be shared at authorized customer service centers, franchises, or approved sales outlets.

stories.title: Pakistan and India Clash in Under-19 Asia Cup Final in Oman
stories.summary:
Pakistan and India are set to renew their cricket rivalry in the final of the Under-19 Asia Cup at the Oman Cricket Academy Ground in Al Amerat, Oman. Defending champions Pakistan enter the match aiming to retain their crown following an unbeaten campaign throughout the continental tournament. Led by Farhan Yousaf, Pakistan won all four of their prior matches, beginning with a nine-wicket victory over the United Arab Emirates and a close three-wicket win against India featuring an unbeaten century from Hamza Zahoor.

Pakistan's path to the final also included a 101-run win over Nepal to top Group A, followed by a nine-wicket semi-final defeat of Bangladesh. In that semi-final, fast bowler Rizwanullah took five wickets for 30 runs, while Hayam Khan and Usman Khan chased the target through an unbroken 123-run opening stand. India finished second in Group A with two wins from three matches, opening with a ten-wicket victory over Nepal, losing to Pakistan, and defeating the UAE by 70 runs. India rebounded in the semi-finals by beating Afghanistan by eight wickets, spearheaded by Lakshya Raichandani's 93 runs off 90 balls.

The fixture carries historical significance, recalling last year's final where Pakistan beat India by 191 runs. Tournament statistics show India's Aaryavir Sehwag leading the batting charts with 303 runs, while Pakistan's Usman Khan has accumulated 238 runs. In bowling, Afghanistan's Noor Ali leads with 14 wickets, followed by Bangladesh's Tafiulm Alam Tamim with 13, and 11 wickets each for Pakistan's Rizwanullah and India's ID Sood. India holds a record seven tournament titles, while Pakistan shares a historical 2012 trophy tie with them.

This high-stakes encounter matters as both regional powerhouses compete for continental supremacy. Pakistan seeks back-to-back crowns, while India looks to avenge previous losses and add another trophy to their historic record.

stories.title: Pakistan Signs Thirteen Mineral Cooperation Deals at Islamabad Forum
stories.summary:
Pakistan finalized over a dozen mineral cooperation agreements and memoranda of understanding with international firms and nations on the final day of the Pakistan Mineral Investment Forum in Islamabad. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir both stressed the necessity of transitioning away from exporting raw materials and unprocessed minerals, urging foreign investors to build complete value chains ranging from exploration to finished products.

During the event, Prime Minister Sharif emphasized that mineral development must incorporate environmental protection, modern technology, and international standards to safeguard water resources and worker safety. Barrick Gold Executive Chairman John Thornton confirmed his company's long-term partnership regarding the Reko-Diq project, where Barrick Gold holds a 50 percent stake. Additionally, Pakistan signed two memoranda of understanding with the United States firm Ivanhoe Atlantic to utilize modern exploration technology.

Thirteen joint ventures and agreements were concluded by Pakistani entities with foreign partners. Notable deals include a joint venture between Turkiye's Lidiya Mining and Mari Minerals for exploration in Chagai, Balochistan; an agreement between UK-based MSALABS and Mari MSA Labs to establish a commercial assay laboratory; and a strategic framework between Turkiye's MTA International Company and Mari Minerals for Chagai mining projects. Other accords involved the Frontier Works Organisation, Ivanhoe Mines, the Geological Survey of Pakistan, German and British geological bodies, and the Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation for exploring minerals such as copper, gold, antimony, and silver across Balochistan and Pishin.

This initiative addresses Pakistan's vast mineral reserves, estimated at roughly $8 trillion across 600,000 square kilometers, which have historically contributed under three percent to the gross domestic product. Officials project that with proper security, governance, and modern infrastructure, annual mineral exports could increase from $3 billion to $8 billion, and GDP growth could rise from three percent to six percent, transforming geological potential into employment, industrial capacity, and bankable projects.

stories.title: Pakistan Faces Bangladesh in Historic SAFF Championship Semi-Final
stories.summary:
Pakistan will chase history by attempting to reach their first SAFF Championship final when they encounter tournament hosts Bangladesh in a semi-final clash at the National Stadium in Dhaka. The visiting squad receives a boost with the late arrival of five overseas-based players—Abdullah Iqbal, Easah Suliman, Ali Akbar Khan, Adil Nabi, and Abdul Samad Shahzad—who missed group matches because their fixtures fell outside the FIFA international window. Their inclusion provides coach Nolberto Solano with additional depth against a Bangladeshi team that has not conceded a goal in the competition.

Pakistan advanced as Group B runners-up with three points, recording a plus-two goal difference after scoring five goals and conceding three across two matches. They started with a 3-2 loss to India, featuring two goals from Suhail Ahmad Bhat and one from Kipgen, before bouncing back with a 3-0 victory over the Maldives powered by 19-year-old Najeeb Ullah Khan's first-half double. Their progression was confirmed when India defeated the Maldives 1-0 via a penalty converted by Suhail.

Bangladesh enters the fixture unbeaten on home soil, having opened with a 1-0 win over Bhutan through substitute Mohammad Ibrahim, followed by a 4-0 victory against Sri Lanka featuring goals from Shamit Shome, Hamza Choudhury, Farhaan Ali Wahid, and Rakib Hossain. Bangladesh is pursuing its second regional title, having last won the tournament in 2003, while Pakistan aims to disrupt the hosts' campaign.

The match matters significantly for regional dominance. In the tournament's other semi-final, defending champions India face Group A runners-up Bhutan, with the final scheduled for November 17.

stories.title: India Prevents Dozens of International Speakers From Attending Opposition Democracy Summit
stories.summary:
India prevented over 100 international speakers from attending a democracy summit organized by the opposition Congress party in Hyderabad. Shashi Tharoor, a Congress member of parliament and former United Nations official, stated that 115 out of 315 speakers cleared by the foreign ministry were denied entry or had their visas canceled. Tharoor criticized the government for attempting to suppress critical viewpoints.

Among those affected was Norwegian journalist Helle Lyng, who had previously questioned Prime Minister Narendra Modi about press freedom during a May visit to Oslo. Following the cancellation of her visa, the Association of Norwegian Editors and the Norwegian Press Association sent an open letter to the Indian Embassy in Oslo, expressing deep concern over the implications for foreign journalists covering the country.

The Editors Guild of India condemned the travel restrictions as bureaucratic overreach, urging authorities to disclose their reasoning and reverse the decision. The two-day event in Hyderabad brought together approximately 1,000 delegates from more than 70 nations to deliberate on topics including democracy, artificial intelligence, climate change, and global cooperation. India's foreign ministry did not immediately reply to requests for comment from journalists.

The controversy underscores ongoing tensions surrounding press freedom and political expression in the nation.
