فیڈرل بورڈ آف انٹرمیڈیٹ اینڈ سیکنڈری एजुकेशन کے چیئرمین ڈاکٹر اکرام علی ملک اور انٹر بورڈز کوآرڈینیشن کمیشن (آئی بی سی سی) کے ایگزیکٹو ڈائریکٹر ڈاکٹر غلام علی ملاح نے اسلام آباد کے آئی ایم سی جی بوائز، I-8/3 کا دورہ کیا۔ اس دورے کا مقصد ہائر سیکنڈری اسکول سرٹیفکیٹ (ایچ ایس ایس سی) کے دوسرے سالانہ امتحانات کے جاری عمل اور انتظامات کا جائزہ لینا تھا۔

دورے کے دوران دونوں عہدے داروں نے امتحانی ہال کا معائنہ کیا اور طلبہ کے لیے کیے گئے انتظامات کا مشاہدہ کیا۔ انہوں نے امتحانی ماحول کو طلبہ کے لیے موزوں اور سازگار قرار دیتے ہوئے مجموعی انتظامات پر اطمینان کا اظہار کیا۔ اس موقع پر امتحانات کے منصفانہ اور ہموار انعقاد کو یقینی بنانے کے امور پر بھی بات چیت کی گئی۔

چیئرمین فیڈرل بورڈ ڈاکٹر اکرام علی ملک نے بتایا کہ امتحانی ہال میں امیدواروں کی حاضری کی ڈیجیٹل اٹینڈنس پورٹل کے ذریعے تصدیق کی جارہی ہے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ اس نظام سے امتحانی عمل میں شفافیت اور جوابدہی یقینی ہوتی ہے اور کسی دوسرے امیدوار کی جگہ امتحان دینے یا جعل سازی کے امکانات ختم ہوجاتے ہیں۔

ایگزیکٹو ڈائریکٹر آئی بی سی سی ڈاکٹر غلام علی ملاح نے امتحانی نظام میں شفافیت، میرٹ اور ساکھ برقرار رکھنے کی اہمیت پر زور دیا۔ انہوں نے فیڈرل بورڈ کے انتظامات کو سراہتے ہوئے کہا کہ ٹیکنالوجی پر مبنی نگرانی کا نظام بے ضابطگیوں کی روک تھام کرتا ہے اور آئی بی سی سی تعلیمی بورڈز کے مابین باہمی تعاون کو فروغ دینے کے لیے پرعزم ہے۔

stories.title: Karachi University awaits Sindh government approval for student council constitution
stories.summary:
The University of Karachi recently submitted its official response to the Sindh High Court regarding a legal petition demanding the revival of student unions and campus elections. In the court filing, university representatives explained that the draft constitution for a Student Council had already been sent to the Sindh Government's Universities and Boards Department on December 12, 2022, for final review and endorsement.

The document was originally drafted by the Central Students Advisory Council before the registrar transmitted it to the provincial department secretary. However, the university noted that the necessary official approval remains pending with the government office, meaning the administrative framework is still under review.

Furthermore, the university argued before the bench that the legal action should be thrown out because the petitioners failed to demonstrate any breach of their fundamental constitutional rights. The institution emphasized that it had already launched the formal process to establish a governing framework and set election procedures, while also highlighting that the High Court had previously dismissed a similar legal challenge.

The litigation was initiated by students from the institution's law school, including Ali Sher Muhammad Haris. The legal challenge relies upon the Sindh Students Union Act, a legislative framework enacted after the Sindh Assembly unanimously passed the relevant bill in February 2022 following extensive consultations that began in 2019. Petitioners contend that educational facilities were legally obligated to establish election regulations within two months of the law taking effect, while legal counsel Usman Farooq argued that existing laws already permit elections without waiting for additional rules. The Sindh High Court ultimately decided to adjourn the proceedings indefinitely.

stories.title: Thai Baht Holds Steady Against US Dollar During Friday Trading Session
stories.summary:
The Thai baht showed very little movement relative to the US dollar during currency trading sessions on Friday morning. Financial data indicates that the currency experienced minimal change as markets opened for the day's business in Bangkok.

Around 0148 GMT, the baht recorded a slight increase of 0.09 percent, reaching a rate of 33.86 against the dollar. Throughout the early trading hours, the currency moved within a relatively narrow band between 33.880 and 33.905.

This performance followed the previous trading session's close, where market records compiled by LSEG showed the exchange rate settling at 33.89 baht per US dollar. Currency analysts observed the steady movement as the exchange rate maintained tight parameters during the early morning hours.

The foreign exchange stability reflected quiet conditions for the Thai currency on Friday. Market participants continued monitoring the currency pair as it hovered close to its previous closing figures without major fluctuations.

stories.title: ByteDance Proposes Six Billion Dollar Share Buyback at Four Hundred Billion Valuation
stories.summary:
ByteDance, the Chinese technology enterprise that owns the popular short-form video application TikTok, is reportedly preparing a major financial maneuver involving its corporate equity. According to a recent report from The Information, the company intends to repurchase a significant portion of its shares from current investors.

The planned share buyback program is expected to reach up to $6 billion in total value. Details of the proposed transaction emerged following the distribution of a letter to the company's shareholders, alongside information provided by an individual with direct knowledge of the corporate plans.

Under the terms outlined in the reported buyback scheme, the massive technology firm would be valued at approximately $400 billion. This valuation reflects the ongoing private market assessment of the multinational enterprise despite various regulatory challenges surrounding its flagship social media platform globally.

The proposed repurchase offers current investors an opportunity to liquidate portions of their holdings in the privately held corporation. The initiative highlights ByteDance's continued financial strategies amid its standing as one of the most valuable privately owned technology companies in the world.

stories.title: Pakistani Security Forces Eliminate Thirty One Terrorists During Balochistan Sanitisation Operation
stories.summary:
Pakistani security forces successfully neutralized 31 terrorists during an intelligence-led sanitisation operation conducted in the Kurram area of Quetta district. According to statements released by the Inter-Services Public Relations on Friday, military personnel targeted multiple militant hideouts following a series of armed engagements.

The military's media wing explained that the comprehensive counterterrorism mission began on November 3 to target groups backed from abroad. Alongside killing the 31 insurgents, military personnel successfully recovered a substantial quantity of weapons, military ammunition, and explosive materials from the cleared hideout locations.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif formally commended the armed forces for their successful execution of the mission and the destruction of the terrorist strongholds. In an official statement from the Prime Minister's Office, the premier praised the courage, professionalism, and round-the-clock efforts of the security personnel in protecting the nation against hostile threats.

Reiterating the government's resolve, the prime minister stated that the campaign against foreign-sponsored terrorism will persist aggressively under the National Action Plan. The ISPR further confirmed that ongoing counterterrorism efforts will continue at full speed under the Azm-e-Istehkam vision, which was previously approved by the Federal Apex Committee to completely eradicate terrorism from the country.

stories.title: Pakistan Security Forces Eliminate 74 Terrorists in Recent Operations
stories.summary:
Security forces in Pakistan killed 74 terrorists during intelligence-based operations across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan over a recent 48-hour period, according to the military's media wing, the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR). The counterterrorism push included 35 terrorists killed in Mir Ali within the North Waziristan district and eight others in the Orakzai district. These operations targeted networks associated with Fitna-al-Khawarij, a state designation for the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan. During sanitisation efforts, forces recovered a large cache of weapons, ammunition, and homemade explosives.

Additional operations conducted since November 3 in the Kurram area of Quetta district resulted in the deaths of 31 India-backed terrorists, referred to by the state as Fitna-al-Hindustan. The ISPR stated that these engagements targeted multiple hideouts, with security forces recovering further explosives and weaponry. The military affirmed that its broader counterterrorism campaign under the vision 'Azm-i-Istehkam' will continue to eradicate foreign-sponsored terrorism.

Top government officials lauded the security forces for their achievements. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif praised the personnel's professional expertise and courage in destroying hideouts and recovering arms, reaffirming that the war against foreign-sponsored terrorism will persist under the National Action Plan. President Asif Ali Zardari similarly commended the successful operations, stating that the continuous elimination of terrorists reflects the nation's resolve and thwarts external ambitions to undermine Pakistan's peace and stability.

The security landscape remained volatile, with the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies (PICSS) reporting 49 militant attacks nationwide between October 30 and November 5, leading to 25 fatalities and 21 injuries. Previous engagements earlier in October also saw security forces neutralise multiple militants in North Waziristan and other parts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, underscoring the ongoing intensity of the country's counterterrorism efforts.

stories.title: Australian Dollar Slumps to 10-Month Low Amid Rising US Yields
stories.summary:
The Australian dollar dropped near a 10-month low on Friday, driven downward by climbing US yields, a strong US dollar, and fading local yield support. The currency slipped 0.1% to $0.68 after touching $0.6798 overnight, its lowest level since late January, effectively breaking critical support at $0.6835. Meanwhile, the New Zealand dollar, or kiwi, edged down 0.1% to $0.5543, nearing a 19-month low of $0.5529.

The downward pressure on both Oceanian currencies stems from an ascending US dollar, which hovered at its highest level since April of the previous year. This surge is directly linked to sharply higher Treasury yields, as market participants raised expectations for an outsized 50-basis-point rate hike from the Federal Reserve next month to 15%, up from 12% a day prior. Additionally, the Australian dollar faced weight from expectations that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) has finished tightening monetary policy, alongside a broader stock market sell-off prompted by upheaval at chip giant Nvidia.

Sean Callow, a senior FX analyst at ITC Markets, noted that the Australian dollar has proven particularly vulnerable to the steep rise in US yields and risks testing 67 cents unless those yields decline. Callow highlighted that the RBA's implicit message that its next live policy meeting will not occur before February leaves the currency exposed. Furthermore, the premium of Australia's two-year government bond yield over US Treasuries shrank to just 3 basis points, a steep drop from 36 basis points the previous week when the RBA raised interest rates for the fifth time this year while dropping its tightening bias.

Across the Tasman Sea, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand is widely projected to raise interest rates by a quarter-point in December, bringing the rate to 3%, with two additional hikes priced in by the conclusion of the following year. The broader currency dynamics illustrate the stark divergence between local policy stances and the aggressive monetary tightening expectations unfolding in the United States.

stories.title: برطانوی فوج کے میجر جنرل کارل ہیرس کا پاکستانی فوجیوں کی قربانیوں کو خراج تحسین
stories.summary:
برطانوی فوج کے اعلیٰ افسر میجر جنرل کارل ہیرس نے پہلی اور دوسری عالمی جنگ میں برصغیر اور بالخصوص موجودہ پاکستان کے علاقوں سے تعلق رکھنے والے مسلمان فوجیوں کی خدمات کو زبردست خراج تحسین پیش کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ برطانیہ کے دفاع اور آزادی میں جنوبی ایشیا کے فوجیوں نے تاریخی کردار ادا کیا ہے اور ان کی قربانیاں برطانوی تاریخ کا اہم حصہ ہیں۔

یہ خیالات انہوں نے آرمسٹِس ڈے کے موقع پر پاکستانی نژاد برطانوی کاروباری شخصیت اور طارق حلال میٹس کے سربراہ ڈاکٹر طارق شیخ کے ساتھ آرمڈ فورسز کووننٹ پر دستخط کی تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے ظاہر کیے۔ اس معاہدے پر ڈاکٹر طارق شیخ نے اپنی کمپنی جبکہ میجر جنرل کارل ہیرس نے برطانوی وزارتِ دفاع کی نمائندگی کرتے ہوئے دستخط کیے۔

معاہدے کا مقصد برطانوی مسلح افواج کے حاضر سروس اور سابق اہلکاروں کے ساتھ ساتھ ان کے اہل خانہ کو روزگار اور سماجی سہولتوں میں مساوی مواقع فراہم کرنا ہے۔ اس تقریب میں تاریخی تعلقات کو مضبوط بنانے اور مشترکہ فوجی ورثے کو اجاگر کرنے پر بھی روشنی ڈالی گئی۔

تقریب میں ڈاکٹر طارق شیخ نے ذکر کیا کہ پاکستان آرمی کی جڑیں بھی برطانوی ہندوستانی فوج سے ملتی ہیں۔ کمپنی کی چیف فنانشل آفیسر ثائرہ شیخ نے اعلان کیا کہ طارق حلال میٹس میں ملازمت کے لیے درخواست دینے والے ہر سابق فوجی کو انٹرویو کا موقع دیا جائے گا جبکہ فرنچائزز مقامی کیڈٹ یونٹس کی معاونت بھی کریں گی۔

stories.title: Australian Shares Decline as Surging Oil Prices and Mining Stocks Weigh
stories.summary:
Australian shares extended their losses for a second consecutive session on Friday, with most sectors trading in negative territory, led downward by banking and mining stocks. The S&P/ASX 200 fell 0.5% to 9,101.70 by 2321 GMT. Despite the daily decline and pressure from resurgent geopolitical tensions, the index remained on track to secure a third straight weekly gain with an approximate 1% increase.

Earlier in the week, Australian markets participated in a global rally as oil prices hit multi-month lows following remarks by US President Donald Trump downplaying the prospect of renewed strikes on Iran. However, sentiment shifted as escalating attacks on energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia and shipping disruptions at the Strait of Hormuz drove oil prices higher. This resurgence in oil prices revived inflationary pressures that have troubled global economies since the onset of the Iran conflict earlier in the year. Concurrently, short-term government bond yields advanced, with the one-year yield climbing to 4.966% ahead of monthly employment figures due the following week.

Sector-specific results showed mining stocks falling 0.9% in response to lower base metal prices, though major firms like BHP and Rio Tinto—which slipped 0.6% and 0.9% respectively—were still positioned for a 1.8% weekly gain. Financials dropped 0.6% as all four major banks traded in the red, putting the sub-index on course for its second consecutive weekly loss. Technology stocks mirrored overnight declines in the tech-heavy US Nasdaq Composite, slipping 1.2% following a drop in AI chipmaker Nvidia after CEO Jensen Huang's resignation. Energy stocks stood out as an exception, jumping 1.1% with gains of over 1% for Woodside Energy and Santos. In New Zealand, the S&P/NZX 50 fell 0.3% to 14,210.10 from a record high, but remained poised for a 1.4% weekly advance.

stories.title: Carbon Credits Can Boost Pakistan Green Project Revenues by 20 Percent
stories.summary:
Qualifying low-carbon investments in Pakistan can generate additional revenues equal to 10% to 20% of project earnings through carbon credits, according to Khurram Lalani, chief executive of climate finance firm Resources Future. Carbon credits, or carbon offsets, are tradable certificates representing the removal or reduction of one tonne of carbon dioxide equivalent from the atmosphere. They enable businesses to compensate for emissions by backing qualifying projects like renewable energy, afforestation, and mangrove restoration, certified by international standards such as Verra and Gold Standard.

Pakistan's carbon market became operational in early 2025 following the federal approval of guidelines under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement. Lalani described carbon credits as a commodity akin to gold or silver that provides an extra monetisation stream, helping businesses recover operating and maintenance costs. While primary earnings will not double, credits generally contribute 10% to 15% in added revenue, with potential reaching 20%. This potential extends beyond conventional renewable energy to electric vehicles, battery energy storage systems, biodiesel manufacturing, forestry, and agroforestry projects like mango restoration.

Despite this potential, Pakistan has lagged behind regional peers such as India, China, and Bangladesh in developing carbon projects. Lalani attributed this delay to a lack of local awareness, technical capacity, and risk-taking ability among industrialists compared to foreign counterparts. Additionally, high project development costs have historically been a barrier, though Resources Future claims to have reduced typical consulting expenses to under $100,000, framing the expense as a marginal addition to multi-billion-rupee low-carbon investments rather than a separate venture.

Generated carbon credits are predominantly sold to global buyers because the domestic market remains largely international. Furthermore, local commercial banks have yet to introduce dedicated carbon-credit-based financing products, as the local banking sector remains in the early stages of understanding the market. Lalani emphasized that Pakistani industrialists should automatically integrate carbon credit strategies into any low-carbon project design, mirroring practices common in India and China.

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Admits Appeals in £190 Million Case for PTI Founder and Wife
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court has officially admitted appeals filed by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf founder Imran Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi, which challenge their convictions in the £190 million case. A hearing for the appeals has been scheduled for November 18.

A two-member bench consisting of IHC Chief Justice Sarfraz Dogar and Justice Muhammad Asif will preside over the hearings. During the proceedings, the court directed the involved parties to prepare their arguments and ordered the IHC office to finish preparing the necessary paper books for the case within seven days.

In compliance with judicial directions, a meeting between Imran Khan, Bushra Bibi, and their defense lawyers was arranged. A two-page order issued by Chief Justice Dogar and Justice Asif mandated that lawyers Salman Safdar and Latif Khosa must strictly limit their discussions with Imran Khan to legal matters rather than politics, with each meeting lasting at least one hour.

During the court session, Latif Khosa stated he was unable to present arguments because he had not met with his client yet, while Salman Safdar indicated he had received instructions for the appeal but found the meeting duration insufficient. Meanwhile, in unrelated consumer news in Karachi, liquefied petroleum gas is being sold for up to Rs530 per kilogram, significantly exceeding the official rate of Rs294 set by the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority.

stories.title: عالمی اور مقامی سطح پر سونے اور چاندی کی قیمتوں میں نمایاں کمی
stories.summary:
عالمی اور مقامی بازاروں میں سونے اور چاندی کی قیمتوں میں بڑی کمی ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے۔ بین الاقوامی بلین مارکیٹ میں فی اونس سونے کی قیمت میں 49 ڈالر کی نمایاں کمی واقع ہوئی، جس کے بعد یہ قیمت 3 ہزار 891 ڈالر کی سطح پر آ گئی۔ بین الاقوامی مارکیٹ میں اس کمی کے اثرات ملکی صرافہ مارکیٹوں پر بھی براہ راست مرتب ہوئے۔

مقامی مارکیٹوں میں فی تولہ سونے کی قیمت میں 4 ہزار 900 روپے کی کمی ہوئی، جس کے بعد فی تولہ سونا 4 لاکھ 11 ہزار 636 روپے کی سطح پر آ گیا۔ اسی طرح فی 10 گرام سونے کی قیمت میں بھی 4 ہزار 201 روپے کی کمی دیکھی گئی اور یہ 3 لاکھ 52 ہزار 911 روپے کی سطح پر آگئی۔

قیمتوں میں اس گراوٹ کا اثر صرف سونے تک محدود نہیں رہا بلکہ قیمتی دھات چاندی کے نرخ بھی نیچے آگئے ہیں۔ مقامی بازاروں میں فی تولہ چاندی کی قیمت 111 روپے کی کمی کے بعد 5 ہزار 467 روپے ہو گئی ہے۔

مزید برآں، فی 10 گرام چاندی کی قیمت میں بھی 95 روپے کی کمی ریکارڈ کی گئی، جس کے نتیجے میں فی 10 گرام چاندی 4 ہزار 687 روپے کی سطح پر بند ہوئی۔ ان قیمتوں میں کمی سے خریداروں کو کچھ ریلیف ملا ہے۔

stories.title: نئے صوبوں اور ریفرنڈم سے متعلق عوامی مسائل پر گفتگو، ملک محمد احمد خان کا خطاب
stories.summary:
پنجاب اسمبلی کے اسپیکر ملک محمد احمد خان نے لاہور میں ایک تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ نئے صوبوں کے قیام کے حوالے سے ایک خطے کے لوگ اس کے حق میں ہو سکتے ہیں جبکہ دوسرے خطے کے لوگ اسے تسلیم نہ کریں۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ ریفرنڈم کا اصل مقصد ہی کسی مسئلے کا منصفانہ حل نکالنا ہوتا ہے، اور جب عوام خود بول پڑیں تو پھر عوامی نمائندوں کے بولنے یا نہ بولنے سے کوئی فرق نہیں پڑتا۔

اپنے خطاب میں انہوں نے مریم نواز کی حکومت سے بڑی توقعات کا اظہار کیا اور کہا کہ گزشتہ ستر برسوں کے دوران ستر فیصد آبادی کو انسان ہی نہیں سمجھا جاتا تھا اور دیہات میں صحت کی سہولیات کے فقدان کے باعث حالات خراب تھے۔ انہوں نے وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب کی جانب سے صحت کے شعبے میں کیے گئے کاموں کو سراہا۔ اس کے علاوہ انہوں نے کرپشن کے ناسور کو ختم کرنے کے عزم کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے وفاقی وزراء اور رہنماؤں کے مابین ہونے والی ملاقاتوں اور سیاسی امور کا بھی ذکر کیا۔

stories.title: راولپنڈی اسٹیشن کے قریب پشاور سے آنے والی جعفر ایکسپریس کی بوگیاں پٹری سے اتر گئیں
stories.summary:
پشاور سے کراچی جانے والی مسافر ٹرین جعفر ایکسپریس کا پاور پلانٹ اور دو بوگیاں راولپنڈی اسٹیشن کے قریب پٹری سے اتر گئیں۔ ریلوے حکام کے مطابق اس حادثے میں کسی قسم کا جانی نقصان نہیں ہوا اور نہ ہی کوئی مسافر زخمی ہوا۔ حادثے کے بعد مین لائن پر ٹرینوں کی آمد و رفت معطل ہو گئی اور ڈاؤن ٹریک بھی جزوی طور پر متاثر ہوا۔

ریلوے حکام نے فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ٹرین کے آخری تین ڈبے الگ کر کے اسے آگے روانہ کر دیا، جبکہ کرین کی مدد سے پٹری سے اترنے والی متاثرہ بوگیوں کو دوبارہ ٹریک پر لانے کا کام جاری ہے۔ اس واقعے سے ریلوے کے نظام میں عارضی تعطل پیدا ہوا لیکن بروقت اقدامات سے صورتحال کو قابو میں لانے کی کوشش کی جا رہی ہے۔

stories.title: لاہور ہائیکورٹ نے پی ٹی آئی رہنما عثمان اکرم کی نظر بندی کی درخواست نمٹا دی
stories.summary:
لاہور ہائی کورٹ نے پاکستان تحریکِ انصاف کے رہنما عثمان اکرم کی نظربندی کے خلاف دائر کی جانے والی درخواست کو نمٹا دیا ہے۔ یہ فیصلہ اس وقت سامنے آیا جب متعلقہ حکام کی جانب سے عثمان اکرم کی نظربندی کا سرکاری نوٹیفکیشن واپس لے لیا گیا۔ اس مقدمے کی سماعت جسٹس علی ضیا باجوہ کی عدالت میں عمل میں آئی تھی۔

سماعت کے دوران عدالتی حکم پر عمل کرتے ہوئے ڈپٹی کمشنر لاہور ذاتی حیثیت میں عدالت کے روبرو پیش ہوئے۔ انہوں نے عدالت کو آگاہ کیا کہ عثمان اکرم کی نظربندی کا آرڈر منسوخ کر دیا گیا ہے اور اس حوالے سے باقاعدہ رپورٹ بھی پیش کی گئی۔ سرکاری وکیل نے عدالت کو بتایا کہ یہ نوٹیفکیشن لاہور ہائی کورٹ کے چیف جسٹس عالیہ نیلم کی منظوری کے بعد واپس لیا گیا ہے۔

کارروائی کے دوران عدالت نے اہم ریمارکس دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ 26 ویں آئینی ترمیم کے نفاذ کے بعد اب دائر کردہ درخواست میں کی گئی مخصوص استدعا سے باہر نکل کر کوئی حکم صادر نہیں کیا جا سکتا۔ یاد رہے کہ اس سے قبل پی ٹی آئی رہنما عثمان اکرم کی اہلیہ کلثوم عثمان اکرم نے اپنے شوہر کی غیر قانونی نظربندی کو چیلنج کرنے کے لیے لاہور ہائی کورٹ سے رجوع کیا تھا اور یہ درخواست دائر کی تھی۔

اس عدالتی کارروائی سے عثمان اکرم کی نظربندی کا معاملہ خوش اسلوبی سے اختتام پذیر ہو گیا ہے کیونکہ حکومت کی جانب سے ان کی نظربندی کا حکم نامہ باضابطہ طور پر واپس لے لیا گیا تھا۔ عدالت نے فریقین کے دلائل اور پیش کردہ رپورٹ کی روشنی میں اس کیس سے متعلقہ درخواست کو نمٹا دیا۔

stories.title: Jensen Huang Faces Fresh Scrutiny After Third Woman Linked to Scandal
stories.summary:
Jensen Huang is encountering additional controversy regarding his personal life following a report that alleges the former Nvidia chief executive maintained an intimate relationship with a second female employee at the company. Published by Reuters on November 12, the report cites two sources familiar with the situation, though the woman's identity, job title, the timeline of the relationship, and its status remain undisclosed.

This new disclosure compounds existing public scrutiny following reports of two other relationships involving the billionaire executive. The New York Times reported on November 11 on an alleged affair between Huang and Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health care. Additionally, another reported relationship involved Alice Huang, a Chinese business executive whom US intelligence officials suspected of having ties to China’s Ministry of State Security, raising questions regarding potential intelligence targeting.

Huang previously admitted to infidelity regarding his wife of decades, Lori Huang, in a public statement issued on November 8, though he did not name any of the individuals involved. The latest allegations emerged shortly after Nvidia announced Huang's resignation on November 12 amidst mounting controversy. Nvidia representatives declined to comment on the new allegations to Reuters, and Lori Huang has not issued any public statements or announced a separation or divorce.

stories.title: US Senate Committee Seeks Testimony from Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick
stories.summary:
US Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott issued letters on Thursday requesting testimony from former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. The proposed hearings follow significant developments at the AI chip giant, where Huang recently stepped down amid reports of a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, a businesswoman suspected by US authorities of spying for China.

Lawmakers have raised sharp criticisms regarding the administration's hesitation to add numerous Chinese companies to a key US trade blacklist and questioned government oversight of Nvidia's exports to China. Senator Scott emphasized that these reports highlight serious concerns about national technology protection and national security, stating he would consider issuing a subpoena if Huang fails to appear voluntarily.

In addition to the Senate inquiry, leaders of three House committees—including Foreign Affairs panel head Brian Mast, China Select Committee Chair John Moolenaar, and Intelligence Committee Chair Rick Crawford—demanded that Huang and Nvidia General Counsel Tim Teter attend closed-door transcribed interviews on December 1 and December 2. They also summoned Under Secretary of Commerce Jeffrey Kessler to appear at a December 3 hearing.

While China has denied that Alice Huang is involved in espionage, US Attorney General Todd Blanche stated that the Justice Department has not yet reached a final conclusion. The unfolding controversy has significantly impacted the market, erasing approximately $550 billion from Nvidia's market value over a five-day period and prompting the appointment of CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO.

stories.title: NCCIA Probe into Rizwan and Imam Nearing Completion, Says Naqvi
stories.summary:
The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) is approaching the final stages of its inquiry into senior cricketers Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq, according to Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) Chairman Mohsin Naqvi. Speaking to journalists in Lahore on Thursday, Naqvi noted that the agency sought further clarification from Rizwan before concluding its findings, with the investigation expected to wrap up within days.

Despite the ongoing inquiry, Naqvi confirmed that both Rizwan and Imam have been permitted to participate in domestic cricket. The two athletes faced scrutiny following accusations of leaking confidential information and dressing-room details during the national team's 0-3 Test series defeat in England. Meanwhile, Naqvi stated that new central contracts for players have either been finalized or would be completed shortly, despite being roughly three months overdue since previous agreements expired on July 31.

Addressing financial matters related to the Pakistan Super League (PSL), Naqvi remarked that franchise owners should perform proper feasibility studies and not expect quick profits within a year or two. He added that owners wishing to sell their teams at a profit are permitted to do so under established regulations. Naqvi also expressed contentment with the current direction of Pakistan cricket and voiced full support for the team's management.

In addition, Naqvi announced that renovation work at the National Cricket Academy in Lahore has commenced, targeting a completion date of January 31, 2027, to better accommodate training squads. He also highlighted ongoing security force operations that resulted in the killing of 74 terrorists during intelligence-based actions in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.

stories.title: Karachi Police Uncover Staged Robbery and Arrest Foreign Woman's Accountant
stories.summary:
Police in Karachi have uncovered a staged robbery involving Rs375 million after determining that the complainant, an accountant working for a foreign woman, orchestrated the scheme to misappropriate funds. Gizri police arrested the suspect, named Hanif, and successfully recovered Rs250 million while continuing operations to track down the remaining cash.

DIG South Syed Asad Raza explained that Hanif allegedly handed the stolen funds over to an accomplice after reporting that two motorcyclists had intercepted him on I.I. Chundrigar Road and snatched his bag in the Gizri area. Investigators revealed that the foreign woman, who operates a meat export business and resides in Islamabad, had only recently hired Hanif.

Initial instructions given to the accountant involved cashing a cheque worth Rs100 million for a businessman named Essa, but Hanif reportedly encashed additional cheques without authorization. Police are conducting further raids to recover the rest of the missing money and apprehend other individuals connected to the plot.

In a separate case, Multan Police recently arrested a man accused of masterminding a separate fabricated crime involving a staged rape and robbery. That incident was allegedly arranged to falsely implicate a business rival in exchange for financial compensation.

stories.title: Russia Demands Finland Exit NATO and Proposes New European Security Order
stories.summary:
Russian negotiators presented sweeping demands during informal peace talks held in Abu Dhabi to end the war in Ukraine, according to a report published by the German newspaper Bild on Friday. The proposals, shared with European representatives, aim to establish a new European security order by pushing far beyond Ukrainian borders and reviving historical grievances regarding NATO expansion.

Under the terms of the proposal, Russia would retain all currently occupied Ukrainian territory and gain full control of the Donbas region. Ukraine would be required to relinquish remaining areas of Donetsk and Luhansk under its control, while the ports of Odesa and Mykolaiv would face demilitarization and bans on functioning as naval bases. Furthermore, Ukraine would remain permanently non-aligned, barring future NATO membership while keeping open the option to join the European Union.

The Russian peace blueprint also demands that Finland revert to its pre-membership status, effectively leaving NATO, and calls for a complete ban on alliance military bases in the Baltic states of Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Regarding Moldova, the plan outlines a federal republic comprising core Moldovan territory, Transnistria, and Gagauzia, with provisions allowing the latter two regions to hold independence referendums if Moldova joins the EU.

In exchange for these concessions, the Russian side indicated willingness to withdraw nuclear weapons from Belarus and forgo the stationing of intermediate-range missiles in the country. The demands arrive as European leaders and international negotiators continue discussions surrounding regional stability and the framework of any potential conflict resolution.

stories.title: Beau Jessup, Daughter of Lisa Maxwell, Dies at 27 at Columbia University
stories.summary:
Beau Jessup, the 27-year-old daughter of British actress Lisa Maxwell and Paul Jessup, has died unexpectedly while pursuing a master's degree in journalism at Columbia University in New York. Her passing was announced by the university on Instagram on November 11, with administration officials offering deep condolences to her family, friends, and classmates.

Columbia University did not disclose a cause of death but released an unpublished interview conducted last month for its "Notebook" series. Jessup, who was expected to graduate in May 2027, focused her studies on cultural journalism and the influence of institutions and social identity on human understanding. In the interview, she reflected on growing up with a television actress mother, noting how it provided her with a unique perspective on public narratives and media representation.

Prior to her enrollment at Columbia, Jessup studied social anthropology at the London School of Economics and explored performance writing at the University of Cambridge, where she authored her first play titled The Sandbag. She also gained public attention in 2016 after creating SpecialName, an online platform designed to assist Chinese parents in selecting English names for their children.

Neither Lisa Maxwell nor Paul Jessup have issued public statements regarding the sudden loss of their daughter. The university community continues to mourn her passing while remembering her academic dedication and contributions to cultural reporting.

stories.title: Security Forces Kill 43 Terrorists During Operations in Mir Ali and Orakzai
stories.summary:
Pakistani security forces eliminated 43 terrorists during intensive intelligence-based operations in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, according to the military's media wing. The Inter-Services Public Relations reported that 35 militants were killed in Mir Ali within the North Waziristan district, while another eight were neutralized in Orakzai Agency.

The military stated that the operations involved fierce exchanges of fire, delivering a severe blow to militant networks operating under the banner of Fitna al Khawarij, a term used by the state for the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan. Troops also recovered a large collection of weapons, ammunition, homemade explosives, and improvised explosive devices during subsequent area sanitisation.

According to the military, these rapid recoveries successfully thwarted the terrorists' plans to utilize the hazardous materials in upcoming attacks. Sanitisation procedures are ongoing in both regions to clear out any remaining holed-up insurgents.

The latest security operations coincide with broader administrative and counterterrorism measures across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, where local authorities have recently implemented bans on private jirgas in Peshawar while grappling with persistent security challenges.

stories.title: Sindh JIT Seizes Licensed Pistol of Late Businessman Mir Raza's Partner
stories.summary:
A Joint Investigation Team established by the Sindh government has confiscated the licensed pistol belonging to the business partner of the late Mir Raza Ali. The 25-year-old businessman's body was discovered on July 29, 2026, bearing a gunshot wound inside bushes opposite the main gate of the University of Karachi in Gulistan-i-Jauhar. He had been reported missing from his PECHS residence the previous day.

West DIG Irfan Baloch, who leads the JIT, stated that the North Nazimabad branch of the food chain previously run by the victim has also been sealed as part of the ongoing inquiry. Authorities have taken control of the food chain and seized its records, while the recovered weapon has been dispatched to the police forensic science laboratory for detailed analysis.

The JIT was created following the recommendation of a judicial commission led by Sindh High Court Justice Omar Sial. While initial police investigations labeled the incident a suicide, the family disputed this conclusion. The judicial commission subsequently criticized the initial police probe, determined that the death was a murder, and recommended the formation of the JIT to thoroughly examine all aspects of the case.

The inquiry matters because it seeks to uncover the truth behind the suspicious death of a young business owner and address shortcomings in early police investigations. Investigators are currently reviewing the seized evidence and records to establish accountability and determine the exact circumstances surrounding the tragedy.

stories.title: امریکی ریاست میں 11 ماہ کا لاپتہ بچہ زندہ بازیاب
stories.summary:
امریکہ کی ریاست جنوبی کیرولائنا میں ایک گیارہ ماہ کے لاپتہ بچے کو زندہ بازیاب کرا لیا گیا ہے۔ حکام کے مطابق اس معصوم بچے کو اس کے پچیس سالہ والد مائیکل کومر نے ایک صندوق میں زندہ دفن کر دیا تھا۔ یہ واقعہ اس وقت سامنے آیا جب پیر کے روز کومر بچے کو اس کی والدہ کے گھر سے اپنے ساتھ لے گیا تھا، جہاں وہ نانی کی نگرانی میں تھا۔

پولیس نے پیر کی شام کومر کو چوری کے ایک مقدمے میں گرفتار کر لیا لیکن بچہ اس کے ساتھ موجود نہیں تھا۔ پولیس اور فائر ڈیپارٹمنٹ کے ایک سو اہلکاروں پر مشتمل ٹیم نے بچے کی تلاش شروع کی۔ پوچھ گچھ پر والد نے مطمئن نہیں کیا تو حکام نے جنگل میں تلاش کے دوران ایک جگہ کھدائی کی جہاں سے بچے کے رونے کی آواز سنائی دی۔

بچہ ایک چھوٹے صندوق میں بند تھا جو غالباً تولیے میں لپٹنے کی وجہ سے آکسیجن حاصل کرتا رہا اور سردی کی وجہ سے محفوظ رہا۔ حکام کا خیال ہے کہ بچہ تقریباً چوبیس گھنٹے تک زمین کے اندر دفن رہا ہے۔ شیرف جے کون کے مطابق بچے کو فوری طور پر طبی امداد کے لیے ہسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے جہاں اس کی صحت یابی کی توقع ہے۔

بچے کے والدین کے تعلقات میں تناؤ تھا اور ملزم کے خلاف ماضی میں گھریلو تشدد کا ریکارڈ موجود ہے۔ دادی پیٹریشیا کومر نے بتایا کہ وہ کبھی نہیں سوچ سکتیں تھیں کہ ان کا بیٹا ایسا گھناؤنا فعل کر سکتا ہے۔ پولیس اب ملزم کے خلاف مزید قانونی کارروائی اور الزامات طے کرنے پر غور کر رہی ہے۔

stories.title: European Space Agency's Euclid Telescope Releases Massive Initial Universe Dataset
stories.summary:
The European Space Agency has published its inaugural major collection of data from the orbiting Euclid telescope, encompassing observations of over 900 million galaxies. Released on Thursday, the dataset covers a survey area equivalent to roughly 9,500 times the size of the moon. The mission aims to construct the largest three-dimensional atlas of the cosmos, eventually mapping more than a third of the sky by 2031.

Encompassing approximately 13 months of observations and totaling 1.7 petabytes of data, the release marks a significant milestone for the mission. Valeria Pettorino, ESA's Euclid project scientist, noted that the spacecraft launched from Florida in 2023 to investigate the universe's expansion, structure formation, and the roles of gravity, dark matter, and dark energy over a span of 10 billion years.

The mission seeks to reconstruct the cosmic web, mapping how galaxies cluster along filaments and occupy voids. Understanding this architecture is crucial, as the configuration depends heavily on dark matter and dark energy. While ordinary matter accounts for about 5 percent of the universe, invisible dark matter makes up roughly 27 percent, and dark energy accounts for approximately 68 percent.

The newly unveiled dataset represents just 14 percent of the total sky area that Euclid will survey over its six-year mission in visible and near-infrared light. Scientists utilize gravitational lensing—where foreground matter bends and distorts light from distant galaxies—to analyze these cosmic components. The complete data release, including initial results on dark energy and dark matter, is scheduled for next year.

stories.title: Pakistan Welcomes Global Mining Investment at High-Level Ministerial Meetings
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Petroleum Ali Pervaiz Malik hosted a series of bilateral discussions with prominent international engineering, mining, and investment corporations during the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum. The engagements were designed to reinforce Pakistan's dedication to securing foreign investment and building international partnerships within the domestic minerals sector.

The minister held separate talks with John Thornton, Chairman of Barrick Mining Corporation and senior leadership; Andrew Neilson, Chief Executive of Weir; Ibrahim El Gazzar, Head of Metals and Minerals for the Middle East and North Africa at Trafigura; and Mustafa Aksoy, CEO of Türkiye's Çalık Holding. He also met with a delegation led by Robert Friedland of Ivanhoe Mines.

During the discussions, Weir expressed ambitions to expand its footprint in the country beyond its existing involvement in Reko Diq. Trafigura indicated strong interest in the Zinc-Barite project, alongside prospective opportunities in LPG, bonded storage, and refineries. Meanwhile, Barrick Mining Corporation reaffirmed its ongoing engagement in the nation's mining industry.

Additionally, the Federal Minister witnessed the formal signing of an exploration agreement between Ivanhoe Mines and Mari Minerals to evaluate copper and gold deposits in Chagai, Balochistan. The minister emphasized that the forum functions as a vital platform connecting global investors with emerging prospects, accelerating the development of the country's mineral resources.

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange Trades Marginally Higher Amid Global Market Volatility
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange experienced volatility during the opening minutes of Friday's trading session, with the benchmark KSE-100 Index trading marginally higher. By 10:00 am, the index hovered at 177,506.80, marking an increase of 133.04 points or 0.08 percent. Positive buying activity was registered across several key sectors, including commercial banks, oil and gas exploration companies, oil marketing companies, and refineries, with major stocks trading in the green.

The modest recovery followed a turbulent session on Thursday, during which the KSE-100 Index declined by 1,710.04 points, or 0.95 percent, to close at 177,373.76 points. That sharp downturn was driven by renewed midday selling pressure as investors exercised caution amid ongoing domestic political uncertainty.

Globally, Asian equities stabilized on Friday following a turbulent week marked by the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang amid revelations of extramarital affairs, which sent shockwaves through the artificial intelligence industry. The departure of Huang—who maintained close ties with US President Donald Trump and championed access to the Chinese market—raised concerns regarding future US chip export policies and supply chains. Nvidia shares dropped three percent in extended trading, while customer stocks extended losses.

Despite the international turmoil, broader markets found some footing. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan rose 0.26 percent, reversing a portion of the previous session's 1.3 percent decline. South Korea's Kospi advanced 2.35 percent, and Japan's Nikkei added 1.4 percent, while Nasdaq and S&P 500 futures each climbed over 0.2 percent.

stories.title: OECD Report Shows Developed Nations Experienced Declining Migration in 2025
stories.summary: According to a report published on Thursday by the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), permanent migration to developed countries decreased for the second consecutive year in 2025. The 38 member countries welcomed 6.1 million new permanent immigrants last year, representing a 1.6 percent drop from the 6.2 million recorded in the previous year. This downward trend coincides with a growing political backlash across various Western nations against irregular migration driven by economic hardship, conflict, and authoritarian governments. Specifically, legal humanitarian migration experienced a sharp 26 percent decline in 2025 compared to 2024, whereas labor migration grew by 13 percent. Major declines in permanent arrivals were noted in several countries, with the United Kingdom falling 32 percent, Canada dropping 19 percent, and the United States decreasing by 14 percent. Conversely, a few nations saw significant spikes due to policy adjustments and administrative backlogs; Portugal surged 139 percent to 313,600 individuals, Italy rose 45 percent to 248,800 people, and Spain increased 25 percent to 460,500 individuals. Despite the overall annual dip, long-term permanent immigration remained 12 percent higher than pre-pandemic figures from 2019. India maintained its position as the primary country of origin in 2024, followed by China and Colombia. Asylum applications to OECD countries—excluding the United States—dropped by 22 percent to 1.1 million in 2025, though this figure stayed roughly 10 percent above 2019 levels. Men continued to make up the majority of new arrivals, with women accounting for about 46 percent of immigrants in 2024. The OECD emphasized that welcoming migrants offers a vital opportunity to strengthen long-term productivity and counter shrinking work-age populations, noting that the collective working-age population is projected to shrink by 8 percent by 2060. Mark Pearson, the acting director of Employment, Labour and Social Affairs at the OECD, highlighted that reviving productivity growth is essential for preserving living standards amidst these demographic shifts.

stories.title: Significant Copper and Gold Reserves Discovered in Balochistan's Chagai District
stories.summary:
Mari Energies Limited has announced a major copper and gold discovery in Balochistan's Chagai district, located approximately 50 kilometres east of the Reko Diq mining project. The finding was officially submitted to the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Friday by the company, which stated that its wholly owned subsidiary identified the mineralisation at the East Siah Diq target in the Koh-i-Sultan area.

The exploration work involved completing around 25,000 metres of drilling across Phase 1A and Phase 1B, with all holes reaching a depth of 500 metres. The drilling revealed copper mineralisation beneath roughly 100 metres of sediment across an area spanning 1.4 square kilometres, identifying the site as a new porphyry copper discovery. The primary mineral found is chalcopyrite, alongside occurrences of pyrite, bornite, molybdenum, and copper oxide minerals.

Laboratory analysis for the first drilling phase has concluded, while testing for Phase 1B is currently underway with a completion target in the first quarter of 2027. SGS Pakistan handled sample preparation and testing, utilizing certified reference materials from Australia's OREAS. The technical data was reviewed and approved by Dr John Mortimer of JM Geoscience Pty Ltd.

Further drilling is planned to test depths of up to 1,000 metres to establish an initial geological model and resource estimate. However, the company noted that additional testing and assessments are necessary to confirm the exact economic size and development potential of the find, meaning the results do not yet represent a formally established mineral resource or reserve.

stories.title: Two Arrested After Pet Lioness Fatally Attacks Farmhouse Worker in Lahore
stories.summary: Police in Lahore arrested a farmhouse owner and a TikToker on Thursday following an incident where a 19-year-old farm employee was fatally attacked by a pet lioness in the Kahna area. A spokesperson from the deputy inspector general of police office identified the detained suspects as the farmhouse owner, Fayyaz, and a TikToker named Nauman. According to authorities, Nauman had come to the property to record a TikTok video when the captive lioness lost control and mauled the worker, named Talha, causing critical injuries. The victim was subsequently transferred to a private hospital, where he passed away while receiving treatment. Investigators discovered that individuals involved initially tried to cover up the true nature of the event by falsely claiming the worker had been attacked by a dog. However, a formal inquiry confirmed that the fatal injuries were inflicted by the big cat. Following the revelation, the wildlife department seized the animal, and the victim's body was moved to a morgue to undergo a postmortem examination. Local law enforcement is currently examining whether the facility possessed a proper permit to house the lioness and if adequate safety precautions were implemented. DIG Operations Faisal Kamran stated that investigators will thoroughly probe the deliberate attempt to hide facts and all potential instances of negligence. He emphasized that human life must never be compromised for entertainment or personal gain, asserting that filming TikTok content cannot take precedence over a person's life.

stories.title: Global Microsoft Outage Disrupts Outlook and Teams Services for Hours
stories.summary: Microsoft services, including Outlook and Teams, experienced widespread disruptions lasting approximately 10 hours on Friday as the technology corporation worked to resolve unexpected server failures. The technical malfunction severely impacted businesses and government institutions worldwide that rely on these core platforms. In an official update, Microsoft reported that serviceability improvements were not advancing as anticipated, prompting engineers to identify alternative workstreams to expand capacity amid ongoing traffic management imbalances. DownDetector recorded high volumes of user complaints, highlighting thousands of Outlook issues in the United States and similar outages across Asia-Pacific nations such as Australia, India, and Japan. In a service health notice, Microsoft explained that Microsoft 365 features reliant on Exchange Online and email functionality were impacted, whereas features independent of Exchange Online continued to operate normally. Australian Home Affairs and Cyber Security Minister Tony Burke stated that Microsoft confirmed the incident was unrelated to any cyberattack, comparing the situation to a previous faulty update issue similar to the 2024 CrowdStrike malfunction. Government entities, including the Australian federal police, its spy agency, and the US House of Representatives, reported being affected by the service disruption and coordinated directly with Microsoft engineers. The technology company noted that while some servers unexpectedly became unavailable without a surge in traffic, it was actively rerouting traffic and steadily restoring impacted servers. OpenAI and Anthropic also reported issues regarding disruptions to their respective Microsoft 365 connectors. The tech giant's latest disruption follows an Azure cloud platform outage last month, and the current software failure prompted companies like electric truck manufacturer Workhorse Group to postpone their scheduled third-quarter financial results.

stories.title: Matt Henry's Career-Best Bowling Leads New Zealand to Massive Win Over India
stories.summary:
New Zealand secured a resounding 244-run victory over India in the fourth ODI at Mount Maunganui on Friday, cutting India's series lead to 2-1 with one match remaining. Fast bowler Matt Henry spearheaded the triumph with a career-best performance of 6-27, tearing through India's top order in a devastating opening over by dismissing Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, and Shreyas Iyer all for ducks. Returning to the Black Caps after missing three games due to a concussion-causing head clash with Devon Conway, Henry capitalized on strong winds and sharp movement to help dismantle the visitors for just 89 runs.

Chasing a daunting target of 334, India never mounted a recovery, with Ishan Kishan managing a top score of only 27. Earlier in the match, New Zealand posted 333 all out in their final over after being sent in to bat. Opener Will Young anchored the innings with a brilliant 125 off 108 balls, hitting 14 fours and four sixes to notch his fifth ODI century. Young benefited from early fortune, surviving two dropped catches in the second over.

Young found strong support from Tim Seifert, who smashed a rapid 50 off 39 deliveries, and later from Finn Allen, who contributed 41 runs off 30 balls during a quick 90-run partnership. Despite late bowling contributions from India's Axar Patel, Auqib Nabi, and Gurnoor Brar, who each claimed two wickets, the visiting side's batting lineup collapsed entirely against Henry's historic spell. India captain Iyer noted that the team tried various tactics on a tough batting pitch, but the early fielding errors and relentless bowling proved decisive.

The lopsided outcome sets up a decisive final match in the series scheduled for Sunday. For New Zealand, the emphatic win provides significant momentum, while India must regroup quickly to address vulnerabilities exposed by Henry and the home side's aggressive batting attack.

stories.title: Australia Crushes England by Seven Wickets in Opening ODI in Perth
stories.summary:
Australia secured a dominant seven-wicket victory over England in the opening one-day international at Perth's Optus Stadium on Friday, courtesy of standout performances from debutant Mahli Beardman and captain Mitchell Marsh.

After winning the toss and electing to field, Marsh watched twenty-one-year-old Beardman dismantle the English batting lineup. Beardman claimed six wickets for twenty-four runs in thirty-three point four overs, recording the best bowling figures by an Australian on debut in one-day internationals. Left-arm bowler Spencer Johnson provided strong support by taking three wickets for forty-two runs. England struggled on the drop-in pitch, losing seven wickets for forty-one runs and slumping to sixty-five for eight before being bowled out for a total of one hundred and thirty-one. Gus Atkinson finished as the visitors' top scorer with twenty-nine runs not out from thirty-two balls, while Will Jacks contributed twenty-five runs.

In response, Australia made short work of the target despite losing Travis Head on the very first delivery to Atkinson. Marsh launched an aggressive counter-attack, smashing fifty runs from twenty-nine balls with four boundaries and four sixes to the delight of the home crowd. Cooper Connolly added twenty-seven runs, and contributions from Josh Inglis, who made twenty-three, and Matt Renshaw, who scored twenty-six, comfortably guided the hosts to victory.

Following the match, Marsh praised Beardman's impressive debut, noting that the young fast bowler represents the future as veteran players approach retirement. England captain Harry Brook acknowledged that his team failed to execute their skills properly against a disciplined Australian bowling attack that maintained accurate lines and lengths.

The three-match series now moves to Adelaide, where the two teams are scheduled to contest the second match on Sunday.

stories.title: State Bank of Pakistan Increases Currency Transaction Report Threshold to Rs3 Million
stories.summary: The State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) announced an immediate upward revision of the Currency Transaction Report (CTR) threshold to Rs3 million on Thursday. Prior to this adjustment, the reporting limit stood at Rs2 million, as outlined in the Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU) Guidelines for Reporting Entities issued in 2021. Under these updated parameters, financial institutions and regulated entities are mandated to report only cash transactions that meet or exceed this newly established monetary limit directly to the FMU. In accordance with the Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2010, all required CTR submissions must be delivered to the FMU promptly, and no later than seven working days following the execution of the transaction. The central bank emphasized that receiving comprehensive, precise, and current data through these reports is critical for generating high-quality financial intelligence products. This regulatory change forms part of ongoing reviews to strengthen the country's anti-money laundering framework and oversight mechanisms across the domestic banking and financial sector.

stories.title: Kuwait Introduces Digital Entry and Exit Travel Notifications on Sahel App
stories.summary:
The Kuwait Ministry of Interior has launched a new travel notification service via the Sahel unified government application. This feature allows citizens and expatriate residents to receive alerts regarding their departures from and entries into the country. Users can conveniently view their travel records and access government services related to arrival and departure procedures directly through the digital platform. Additionally, individuals can report any errors or discrepancies found in their travel documentation, supporting the goal of enhancing digital accessibility and transparency.

The Sahel application serves as a unified digital portal designed to simplify government transactions by connecting multiple ministries and state agencies. Citizens and residents can use the free app to manage tasks such as checking official documents, receiving real-time updates, renewing Civil IDs, and paying traffic fines without visiting government offices or waiting in queues. The platform currently hosts more than 500 transactions across over 40 government entities.

The introduction of this travel feature aims to provide greater convenience for the public in managing their travel-related information through digital government infrastructure. By centralizing these services, the application eliminates the need for physical presence for routine paperwork. This update continues the platform's expansion as a comprehensive tool for daily administrative needs in Kuwait.

stories.title: Pakistan Women's Captain Fatima Sana Advocates for Greater Overseas Opportunities and Equality
stories.summary:
Pakistan women's cricket team captain Fatima Sana has voiced her strong support for expanding international opportunities for female players from her country, emphasizing the role such experiences play in developing the domestic game. In a recent interview, Sana discussed her current stint with the Perth Scorchers in Australia's Women's Big Bash League (WBBL), where she plays alongside elite international athletes like New Zealand all-rounder Sophie Devine. She noted that competing in a high-level environment has been instrumental in her personal growth and serves as inspiration for younger generations.

Sana expressed a desire to see more Pakistani women participate in the WBBL to strengthen the overall structure of women's cricket within the ICC framework. By increasing the visibility of female athletes on global platforms, she believes families will feel more encouraged to support their daughters' ambitions in sports. Furthermore, the national captain voiced hope that men's and women's cricket will eventually achieve equal recognition and support from crowds and administrators alike, stressing that athletic participation is equally valuable regardless of gender.

Reflecting on her career path, Sana recalled playing cricket with her brothers in Karachi before rising through domestic ranks to make her international debut against South Africa in 2019. Known for her skills as a pace-bowling all-rounder, she earned the ICC Women's Emerging Cricketer of the Year award in 2021 and was appointed national captain ahead of the 2024 ICC Women's T20 World Cup. Her ongoing participation in the WBBL makes her only the second Pakistani woman to compete in the Australian franchise tournament, following former captain Nida Dar's appearance in 2019.

Sana's advocacy comes as she continues to make an immediate impact abroad, taking two wickets for 27 runs in her debut match for the Scorchers against the Melbourne Renegades. Through her leadership on the field and her calls for systemic equity, she aims to pave the way for a more inclusive future for women's cricket in Pakistan.

stories.title: Delhi Overtakes Lahore as World's Most Polluted City Amid Severe Smog
stories.summary:
India's capital, Delhi, surpassed Lahore on Friday to rank as the world's most polluted city, as hazardous air quality and dense smog enveloped the metropolis of 20 million residents. According to the Swiss air quality monitoring group IQAir, Delhi recorded a hazardous Air Quality Index (AQI) of 334. Meanwhile, India's Central Pollution Control Board reported an even higher AQI of 403, categorizing the condition as severe due to differing measurement scales and methodologies.

The heavy pollution significantly reduced visibility, obscuring street lights and forcing vehicles to navigate through thick smog on main roadways. This seasonal crisis affects numerous areas across northern India and neighboring Pakistan during winter, as cold and heavy air traps emissions from vehicles, construction dust, and agricultural residue burning.

Prior to Delhi claiming the top spot, Lahore consistently held the highest global pollution ranking, with several cities across Pakistan's Punjab province recording AQI readings of 500 or higher. A recent report by the Pakistan Air Quality Initiative indicated a 32 percent increase in Lahore's air pollution compared to the previous year. Although Lahore's morning AQI improved slightly from 444 to 346 over a 24-hour period, toxin concentrations remained exceptionally high.

Alarming air quality levels also persisted across other parts of Punjab. IQAir data showed extreme AQI readings in Raiwind at 519, Bahawalpur at 515, and Multan at 507, while Gujranwala registered 411. Additional monitoring networks reported AQI levels reaching up to 500 in cities such as Kasur, Jhang, Nankana Sahib, Okara, Pakpattan, and Sahiwal, presenting severe health risks across the region.

stories.title: روس اور ایران کے تعلقات آبنائے ہرمز کی ناکہ بندی کے بعد
stories.summary:
فروری میں امریکہ اور اسرائیل کی جانب سے ایران کے خلاف جنگ کے آغاز کے بعد سے روس کو بالواسطہ طور پر کئی فوائد حاصل ہوئے ہیں۔ ایرانی بندرگاہوں کی امریکی ناکہ بندی کے نتیجے میں تیل کی بلند قیمتوں سے روس کو غیر متوقع منافع مل رہا ہے اور اس کی توجہ اپنے مخالفین سے ہٹ رہی ہے۔

امریکہ کی جانب سے ایرانی بندرگاہوں کی ناکہ بندی اور یوکرینی حملوں کے باعث روسی بندرگاہوں کی بندش کے بعد 2026 کے وسط سے بحیرۂ کیسپین کے پار بحری روابط میں نمایاں اضافہ دیکھا گیا ہے۔ ماہر نیکیتا سماگن کے مطابق دونوں ممالک کی تنہائی نے انہیں تعاون پر مجبور کیا ہے، اور بحیرۂ کیسپین کے راستے روس ایران کو فوجی پرزہ جات فراہم کرتا ہے جبکہ ایران روسی اناج کی خریداری بڑھا رہا ہے۔

روسی صدر ولادیمیر پوتن نے 27 اکتوبر کو ایرانی صدر مسعود پزشکیان سے ملاقات کے دوران دو طرفہ تجارت میں اضافے اور مکمل یکجہتی کا اظہار کیا۔ اس کے علاوہ روسی وزیر خارجہ سرگئی لیوروف نے تہران کے دورے کے دوران انسانی امداد فراہم کرنے اور معاشی معاہدوں پر عمل درآمد جاری رکھنے کا عزم ظاہر کیا۔

روس ایران کو توانائی کے شعبے میں بھی سہولتیں دے رہا ہے کیونکہ ایران سردیوں میں شمالی علاقوں کو گیس فراہم کرنے سے قاصر ہے۔ روسی وزیر توانائی سرگئی تسیویلیوو نے بتایا کہ روس اور ایران آذربائیجان کی پائپ لائن کے ذریعے گیس سپلائی کے معاہدے پر بات کر رہے ہیں، جس پر تینوں ممالک کے وزراء متفق ہو چکے ہیں۔

ماہرین کے مطابق خطے کے اس عدم استحکام اور خلیجی بحران سے روس سب سے زیادہ فائدہ اٹھا رہا ہے، جس سے اس کی تیل و گیس کی آمدن میں اضافہ ہوا ہے۔ تاہم روس اپنے دیگر مشرق وسطیٰ کے شراکت داروں کو ناراض کرنے سے بچنے کے لیے محدود مدد فراہم کر رہا ہے۔

stories.title: Islamabad Set to Become Pakistan's First Cashless City by December 31
stories.summary:
Islamabad is scheduled to become Pakistan's first fully cashless city by the end of the year, following a high-level meeting chaired by Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry on Friday. Under the initiative, cash payments will be officially discontinued across all departments of the Islamabad Capital Territory and the Capital Development Authority after November 30.

To achieve the December 31 deadline, the government aims to integrate all merchants in the capital into the digital payment framework. Currently, 26,000 merchants have already been connected to the system. Officials intend to roll out digital payment options everywhere from large commercial centres to street vendors, a shift expected to enhance financial transparency, improve tax monitoring, and streamline transactions.

The project is being executed rapidly following special directives from Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi. Banking sector representatives have offered their full cooperation to support the transformation. The meeting follows recent government push for a nationwide digital economy, which includes promoting the Raast QR Code initiative and ensuring broad internet connectivity and public access to technology.

stories.title: Iran Revolutionary Guards Claim Attack on US Radar Asset in Bahrain
stories.summary:
Iran’s Revolutionary Guards stated on Friday that they successfully targeted a US early-warning radar stationed in Bahrain. According to Iranian state media, this military action served as retaliation for a prior air attack against a telecommunications tower located in Iran’s southern Sirik county within Hormozgan province. This marks the first reported claim of an attack by Iranian forces on American military assets in any Gulf nation since early September.

The claim arrives during a fragile lull in the ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran, which originally began following joint US and Israeli strikes on Iran on February 28. The hostilities subsequently expanded across the region, involving Iranian missile and drone attacks against US bases in Gulf states, efforts by Tehran to restrict shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, and a reciprocal US naval blockade on Iranian ports. Neither United States nor Bahraini officials provided immediate comments regarding the alleged radar strike.

Simultaneously, President Donald Trump stated that the United States does not require a deal with Iran, instructing Vice President JD Vance to focus entirely on domestic crime and corruption in Democratic-run cities. Trump’s directive followed media reports concerning potential peace talks and came as the administration signaled confidence that its existing economic sanctions and naval blockade are sufficient, rendering further diplomacy or military escalation unnecessary.

stories.title: Pakistan National Population Council Declares Rapid Growth a National Emergency
stories.summary:
Officials in Islamabad have classified Pakistan's rapid population expansion as a national emergency requiring immediate coordinated intervention. The decision was reached during the inaugural session of the Executive Committee of the National Population Council, held at the Planning Commission. The gathering was co-chaired by Planning and Development Minister Ahsan Iqbal and Health Minister Mustafa Kamal, with federal ministers, provincial ministers, and senior officials from all four provinces, Azad Jammu and Kashmir, and Gilgit-Baltistan in attendance.

According to Mr. Iqbal, the national growth rate climbed back up to 2.55 percent in the 2023 census after previously declining to 2.4 percent since 1980. He warned that matching population expansion with available resources is vital, noting that a 2.5 percent population increase diminishes a 5 percent economic growth rate down to a 2.5 percent per capita gain. He also criticized the existing National Finance Commission award formula for allocating 82 percent of resources based on population, which he argued inadvertently encourages growth, and suggested tying disbursements to development and sustainability indicators instead.

During the meetings, participants reviewed the draft National Health and Population Policy and the National Population Stabilisation Programme. Regional bodies were instructed to establish provincial population councils, draft costed implementation plans, and integrate missing data streams into the Contraceptive Logistics Management Information System. Authorities also stressed the importance of birth spacing to protect maternal and child health.

Parallel consultative dialogues were organized by the Population Council and the United Nations Population Fund to engage religious scholars, health experts, and policymakers regarding family well-being. Dr. Ali Mohammad Mir, country director of the Population Council Pakistan, noted that a mother dies in the country every 37 minutes. Religious leaders, including Ruet-i-Hilal Central Committee Chairman Maulana Abdul Khabeer Azad and Council of Islamic Ideology Chairman Allama Raghib Hussain Naeemi, affirmed that protecting mothers and children aligns with Islamic teachings.

stories.title: Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar Reviews Austerity and PNSC Restructuring
stories.summary:
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar chaired two separate high-level meetings in Islamabad on Friday to assess government austerity measures and evaluate the planned restructuring of the Pakistan National Shipping Corporation. During the meeting of the Committee for Monitoring and Implementation of Conservation and Additional Austerity Measures, officials tracked progress on expenditure management and resource conservation across various ministries and divisions.

Dar stressed the importance of consistent follow-up and close inter-institutional coordination to curtail avoidable expenditures and boost administrative efficiency. The session included the participation of the IT minister, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister Tariq Bajwa, several federal secretaries, and senior provincial representatives from Azad Jammu and Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan.

In a separate conference, Dar examined strategies to transform the Pakistan National Shipping Corporation into a commercially viable, globally competitive maritime entity aligned with international governance standards. He directed authorities to hire world-class shipping and financial consultants to create a roadmap aimed at maximizing commercial returns and safeguarding national economic interests.

This maritime restructuring meeting was attended by the federal minister for maritime affairs, the maritime affairs secretary, Tariq Bajwa, and other senior officials. Both initiatives form part of the broader governmental push to enforce fiscal discipline and improve the performance of national institutions.

stories.title: Pakistan Demands Halt to Houthi Attacks as UN Security Council Renews Sanctions
stories.summary:
Pakistan has called for an immediate and unconditional end to Houthi military actions against Saudi Arabia as the United Nations Security Council adopted a consensus resolution extending sanctions related to Yemen. The measure maintains asset freezes and travel bans on individuals threatening Yemeni peace until November 14, 2027, and preserves the arms embargo established under Resolution 2216 in April 2015. Additionally, the mandate for the monitoring Panel of Experts was prolonged through December 15, 2027.

Addressing the Security Council, Pakistan’s Permanent Representative to the UN, Ambassador Syed Haider Shah, expressed absolute solidarity with Saudi Arabia and condemned the Houthi offensive. He emphasized that the kingdom holds a legitimate right to defend its territory under international law and the UN Charter. Ambassador Shah also underlined that accountability for actors destabilizing Yemen is crucial for establishing lasting peace, while insisting that the expert panel must operate with strict professionalism and impartiality.

The newly adopted resolution addresses the manufacturing capabilities of the Houthis by targeting their access to precursor chemicals and commercial components used to construct drones and missiles. It tasks council members with determining measures to block the acquisition of specific dual-use items by January 11, based on recommendations from the expert panel. Furthermore, the panel's scope was broadened to examine revenue generated through key economic sectors controlled by the Houthis, and the text notes that arbitrary detentions of UN and diplomatic personnel could trigger further sanctions.

Negotiations leading to the vote involved disagreements among member states. Britain sought to classify the Houthis as a terrorist group, mirroring previous terminology from 2022, but withdrew the push after Russian opposition. China and Russia also voiced objections regarding the proposed dual-use items list and the expanded panel mandate. While Yemen's UN Ambassador Abdullah Al-Saadi welcomed the condemnation of the group, he expressed disappointment over the omission of the terrorist label. Pakistan ultimately reiterated that a sustainable resolution requires an inclusive, Yemeni-led political process under UN guidance.

stories.title: Trump Rejects Iran Deal and Reassigns Vice President Vance to Domestic Corruption
stories.summary:
President Donald Trump announced on Thursday that the United States does not require an agreement with Iran, concurrently instructing Vice President JD Vance to shift his entire focus toward investigating alleged crime and corruption within Democratic-led cities and states. The presidential directive followed media reports that Vice President Vance was contemplating direct peace discussions with a hard-line Iranian security official, and came shortly after Vance attributed the Republican party's midterm election setbacks partly to the financial costs of the ongoing conflict with Iran.

Detailing his stance on social media, President Trump asserted that the period for reaching an accord with Tehran has passed, pointing to accumulated funds and control over the Strait of Hormuz. The administration indicated confidence in its ongoing blockade and economic sanctions, suggesting neither military escalation nor formal diplomacy is necessary. Meanwhile, the U.S. military continues to enforce a blockade on Iranian ports, and Iranian state media reported that four oil tankers sustained damage from explosions after disregarding warnings from Tehran.

Vice President Vance previously engaged in diplomatic outreach by leading talks with Iranian officials in Pakistan in April, which yielded a temporary memorandum of understanding in June before collapsing. Although Iranian state media indicated Tehran recently received a letter from Vance regarding renewed dialogue, President Trump clarified that he did not authorize the outreach. Secretary of State Marco Rubio also dismissed potential negotiations, labeling Iranian demands for war reparations as absurd after conferring with allies in Paris.

Defending the necessity of the military campaign to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons, President Trump redirected Vice President Vance's portfolio toward domestic fraud inquiries. Trump contended that addressing large-scale criminal activity in Democratic municipalities could quickly balance the federal budget. Meanwhile, the Kuwait Ministry of Interior launched a new travel notification service via the Sahel unified application to let residents track entry and exit records.

stories.title: Microsoft Outage Disrupts Outlook and Teams for Thousands Globally
stories.summary:
A major technical disruption affecting Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, and other company applications persisted for more than five hours on Thursday, impacting thousands of users worldwide. The incident also affected connectors utilized by artificial intelligence platforms operated by OpenAI and Anthropic. By early evening, Microsoft reported that it was actively working to restore affected servers to operational status and observed limited recovery as clients gradually reestablished connections.

According to tracking data from Downdetector, complaints regarding Outlook failures peaked at approximately 138,058 around 1 p.m. Eastern Time before declining to roughly 34,490 by the evening. Microsoft initially attributed the service interruption to a subset of servers unexpectedly becoming unavailable due to elevated loads rather than an overall surge in network traffic. By late afternoon, reports for Microsoft 365 dropped to nearly 13,000 users, while Teams disruption reports fell to 763.

The technology corporation stated that restored servers had maintained stability while traffic was actively rerouted through alternate paths to accelerate recovery processes for remaining impacted hardware. OpenAI noted that it was investigating broken connections and tool malfunctions tied to Microsoft connectors, while Anthropic reported an upstream provider issue affecting its own Microsoft 365 integration.

The latest event follows an Azure cloud platform outage last month that similarly disrupted productivity software and global industries. The widespread Microsoft technical failure also forced adjustments in corporate schedules, prompting electric truck manufacturer Workhorse Group to postpone the release of its third-quarter financial results from November 12 to November 16 due to business disruptions.

stories.title: PSX Rebounds Strongly with Over 1,000-Point Gain Before Midday Break
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange experienced a strong recovery during Friday's morning session, climbing more than 1,000 points before trading was temporarily suspended for midday prayers. The benchmark KSE-100 Index reached 178,434.59 points, marking an increase of 1,060.83 points or 0.60% compared to the previous close.

After opening lower, the market steadily recovered from an intraday low of 176,865.05 to hit its session high at the 12:00 pm suspension, completely offsetting the sharp losses recorded the day before. Trading volume in the ready market reached approximately 90 million shares, with a total traded value of roughly Rs9.83 billion.

Buying interest was particularly evident among commercial banks, oil and gas exploration firms, oil marketing companies, and refineries. Prominent market gainers included ARL, PRL, MARI, POL, PSO, SSGC, HBL, MCB, NBP, and UBL, with MARI drawing notable attention following recent corporate developments.

The positive momentum offered relief after a volatile session on Thursday, when political uncertainty caused the index to drop 1,710 points and close at 177,373.76. Market participants are closely watching whether the morning rebound will persist through the afternoon session.

stories.title: Kim Kardashian Faces Scrutiny Over SKIMS Ties Following Lewis Hamilton's Gaza Visit
stories.summary:
Reality television star and entrepreneur Kim Kardashian is facing renewed public criticism regarding her business interests and political associations in Israel. This scrutiny follows statements made by her romantic partner, Formula 1 world champion Lewis Hamilton, who publicly condemned military actions in Gaza and demanded immediate humanitarian relief following a visit to Egypt's Rafah border crossing on November 10, 2026. In an Instagram post the following day, Hamilton called the situation an appalling genocide and urged Israel to fulfill its ceasefire obligations and allow aid trucks into the territory.

Hamilton's outspoken remarks drew attention to Kardashian's commercial footprint in the region, particularly her shapewear brand SKIMS. SKIMS expanded into the Israeli market in November 2025 through an agreement with the retail group Irani Corp. Critics have also highlighted a previous private SKIMS shopping event in Los Angeles that included daughters of Israeli soldiers, an event connected to Hagiborim, an organization supporting children of fallen or injured Israel Defense Forces personnel. Additionally, attention has turned toward Kardashian's past social interactions involving figures like Ivanka Trump and Melania Trump, although she has never formally endorsed Donald Trump and previously supported Hillary Clinton and Joe Biden.

The public divergence between Hamilton's activism and Kardashian's commercial associations has sparked widespread online debate over the compatibility of differing worldviews within a relationship. While some observers question whether such public positions can coexist, others maintain that romantic partners are not required to share identical political beliefs. This controversy highlights broader ongoing discussions surrounding celebrity activism, corporate responsibility, and the extent to which public figures should be held accountable for their associations rather than solely their personal statements.

stories.title: میر رضا کیس: جے آئی ٹی کا اجلاس آج، احمد بھاردے کی پیشی متوقع
stories.summary:
